notes.title: Major Update/New Content Releasing Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Welcome back! We are happy to announce a major update will be releasing for the LotR:ACG tomorrow that will bring new content, a new User Interface, and full offline functionality to the game. As announced in our July road map, we are committed to improving the play experience for our players, and with our first major release since taking over development, we begin that journey tomorrow. 

Here is a breakdown of what will be included in tomorrow's release:

[h2]1. Offline Playability[/h2]

The most requested feature from the community has been to convert the game to be playable offline. After much effort, we are happy to announce the new build will include a fully-functioning, offline single player client that will allow players to play completely offline. Your previous progress will automatically sync locally after updating, after which you can then continue your game sessions offline, without worrying about a network connection.

Of course, co-op multiplayer games will still utilize the online client, and as this release will transition most of the player base off the servers, more bandwidth will be available for your online co-op match plays.

[h2]2. New Adventure Game Mode and Content (UPDATE: CONTENT IS LIVE!) [/h2]
This update will also include, free of charge, a new game mode (Adventures) and our first content pack: "The Fords of Isen", a single-player, story-driven experience that puts players inside an unexplored narrative from the Lord of the Rings books. Draft a deck and play as the mighty Rohirrim, fighting to hold a river crossing from the forces of Saruman. With 70 new cards, 15 locations, new music and unlockables, it brings an all new experience to the game for players to enjoy.  

[h2]3. Progress Respawns[/h2]
We have updated the save system in the game to allow for immediate restoration of your previous location upon death. Previously upon failing in your quests, the game restarted you back at the beginning of your current quest. We have updated this to now restart you at the exact location where you failed, thus allowing for greater exploration and risk taking.

[h2]4. UI Refresh[/h2]
A new main UI will greet you upon entering the game, improving the visual experience and aiding you with content discoverability. Simple vertical and horizontal flows showcase the game’s art and set the initial building blocks for the progress visibility updates which will come in early in 2021.

[h2]5. Bug Fixes[/h2]
Many fixes for bugs and community-reported issues are included in this release as well.

[h3]Release Note 1: Console Parity[/h3]
The new update will be live on Steam tomorrow but will not be submitted to consoles for approval until 10/23. Therefore, until the console versions are approved by their individual platforms and released, cross-play between Steam players and console players will be unavailable until parity is restored (TBD early November). 

[h3]Release Note 2: Active Saves Reset[/h3]
All player game progress will remain intact, however, any active unfinished saves will be reset. Not a big deal, just a heads up.

We will post another announce when the update is live. See you tomorrow!

Thanks,

Antihero Studios

notes.title: 2020 Road Map Announce
notes.notes:
Hello and greetings from Antihero Studios. This is our first post as the new stewards of the game and we hope this news finds you well and in good spirits.

Our development team has been busy digging into the game code and current feature set for the last month and now, we would like to walk you through our future development plans for the game, as well as answer any follow up questions you might have. So, without further ado, here is our development road map for late 2020 through early 2021. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/6abea14116c1d87f2aff1715f481660a81c37432.png[/img]

[h1]Q2 (Before today...)[/h1]
This was the behind-the-scenes working with Asmodee Digital to transfer the project from FFI over to Antihero Studios and work out all the specifics. This is now complete and we have been given the green light to get rolling.

[h1]Q3 2020 (Today through September)[/h1]

[b]Community Recovery[/b]
The once active community channels have fallen dark in the months since the FFI studio closure, and now we are working to relight those beacons. We want to see players sharing and engaging within a vibrant community again, so starting next week, our community manager, Sarah, will be taking the reins of the rebuilding efforts, starting with live streams twice a week. She will be working to rebuild, demoing the game for new players, answering questions, doing developer interviews, and providing the latest updates on new feature and content developments.

[b]Development Begins[/b]
Development of new content, refactors, and bug fixes started Monday (7/21) at full speed. 

[b]Revising Store Pages[/b]
We have plans to refresh the product store pages with updated images, cleaner branding, and a clear message that LotR:ACG is a tactical strategy game.
 
[b]New Game Mode (Adventures)[/b]
We will be bringing a new game mode to the game called Adventure mode. Adventure mode is a new single player, story-based experience that aims to fill a hole in the game’s current play mode line up...the ability to play through key story events from the books. This mode will feature all new gameplay elements such as unique story-based hero cards and abilities, Adventure-only card decks, in-game drafting, and persistence mechanics that extend attachments and stat damage/buffs between quests. Each will be a stand-alone experience and will play out over three quests (10-15 locations). 

Adventures will be offered as purchasable downloadable content similar to the previous DLC content releases, and we will be announcing more details on game features and pricing as we approach release.

[b]DLC#1 and DLC#2 Announce[/b]
We are happy to announce our first two content releases for the game will be the following Adventures: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/eb9b8ebee57b5fdf1ad8dc60adfad6c7db468fc1.png[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/b8767187a1dd1c3dd34366dbaba0574d62d4e820.png[/img]

[h1]Q4 2020 (October to December)[/h1]

[b]Bug Fix Release[/b]
Any past bug reports/Helpshift reports that were submitted have been transferred into our bug tracker and we will try to get as many as possible corrected in the Q4 release. You can submit suggestions or bugs via the Asmodee Digital Helpshift system [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/lord-of-the-rings-acg/]here[/url].

[b]DLC#1 and #2 Release[/b]
Our first two Adventures go live. (see “Adventure Mode” above for more details).

[b]Mirror of Galadriel : Draft Mode (TBD)[/b]
We are working on improving the Mirror of Galadriel (MoG) gameplay. MoG is our quick-play/random-generation mode, and this week we added card drafting. It is early, but we will keep you updated on how it’s going and if it turns out to be good enough to ship with the refactor release.

[b]UI Refresh[/b]
A clean redesign of the menu will be coming as well, with the goal of improving access to all of the content within the game and provide some extra polish. Below are several screen caps of the new in-progress menu redesign:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/404c6ab458fefe2eeea0ae334db69b6a35f123a4.png[/img]

[b]Offline Single Player Client[/b]
Originally the game was designed to be F2P (free-to-play), and thus, currently has an always-on network requirement. We will be releasing a fully offline version of the single-player client which will no longer require a constant connection. You will be able to maintain your current unlocks while also retaining the ability to play online cooperatively. 

[b]DLC #3 Announce[/b]
We will be announcing our plans for our third content release. Currently this is slated to be Campaign 4, with a release target of Jan/Feb.

[h1]Q1/Q2 2021 (January to June)[/h1]

[b]DLC #3 Release[/b]
Our third content release will go live. 

[b]Reward Progress Tracking[/b]
Unlocking extra content in the game is an important secondary challenge the game offers, and we want to provide more visibility into your progress towards those unlocks. The elements providing this feedback will have already been included in the Q4 UI redesign, but they likely won’t be ready to go live until 1Q/2Q.
 
[b]Debulking of Card frames and Cameos[/b]
We are planning on redesigning the card frames and cameos to further separate LotR:ACG from other digital card games currently on the market. As with many of our other changes, these changes will move the visuals in a more lore-focused direction. Below are some early explorations that, though just early wireframe sketches, get the debulking idea across. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/a5812918838c725e9713a2d1c67453c80b3db872.png[/img]

[b]But what about….[/b]
Many of you that have been reaching out to us with ideas, tweaks (difficulty curves, achievements, deck sizes), and new feature requests (mobile platforms, deck codes, etc) might be disheartened that your requested item is not on the list above. Give us time. We are listening. Please keep posting and discussing on the forums/discussion boards/discord and we will do our best to listen/consider/scope/fix those which are both realistically achievable and improve the game experience. 

[b]Risks[/b]
This is an ambitious road map, and we would be remiss if we didn’t acknowledge that we are developing this game during a global pandemic. Our biggest concerns revolve around having everything ready to roll across all six platforms in time for the holiday console submission deadline. Normally, you want to time your console submissions to be into cert by the end of September/early October to avoid the holiday game rush that floods console cert teams each year in November. Now with Covid-19, understandably, they may not be operating at their usual tempo and there may be delays. However, we will do our best to hit our timelines, wrap up early, and keep you updated the whole way.


That’s it! Our 2020 feature road map. Please post any questions/comments/thoughts in the comment section below and we will try to answer them as best we can.

Talk again soon,

Greg
Antihero Studios/LotR:ACG Development Lead

notes.title: Digital tabletop game studio Fantasy Flight Interactive is closing
notes.notes:
Fantasy Flight Interactive, a videogame studio launched in 2017 by board game company Fantasy Flight Games, will close its doors in February. Studio head Tim Gerritsen made the announcement in a message posted to LinkedIn, saying that he's now working to help his employees find new positions. The studio is located in Madison, Wisconsin.

"It's with great sadness that I have to report that the decision has been made to close Fantasy Flight Interactive next month. I'm proud of the team and the game we've dedicated ourselves to for the past few years," Gerritsen wrote.

"It's a been an amazing journey with even more amazing people. I'm going to do my best to get my team placed in new positions. I have programmers, designers, artists, QA staff and a producer to get placed in new roles and will do my best to do so quickly. Additionally, I'm now open to new opportunities myself since I will also be out of a job."

Fantasy Flight Interactive released its first and only game, The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game, on Steam Early Access in August 2018. Full release, as The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game, followed a year later, but despite its early promise it was never able to find an audience: It peaked at 226 concurrent players in September 2018, according to Steam Charts, but immediately declined into double-digit player counts. The full launch briefly pushed it back into low-100s, but its highest concurrent player count since September 2019 was just 86.

Update: Asmodee Digital said in a statement that despite Fantasy Flight Interactive's closure, The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game will continue to be supported.

"We regret FFI’s closure which will be occurring next month and would like to thank the whole team for their hard work and the fruitful collaboration we have enjoyed these last years," a rep said. 

"The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Definitive Edition has been released in December 2019 on PC (Steam) and will be released early 2020 on consoles (PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and Xbox One). We will continue to support the game’s servers, including its co-op multiplayer mode, beyond FFI’s closure, ensuring an optimal experience for players venturing across Middle-earth."

notes.title: News Update (Dec 16, 2019): New Free Content!
notes.notes:
Hail and well met!
It’s time for some big news! We’ve got two major pieces of content rolling out to the game; Campaign 3: [i]The Witch-king’s Grasp[/i], and the all-new [i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i] mode. You'll get both an entirely new narrative experience and a robust new random mode. Plus, they’re all entirely free to all players on Steam!

We’re sure you have questions about it, and we’re here to give you answers:

[quote][b]When is all this coming out?[/b]
You can play Campaign 3 and the [i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i] mode on Steam starting [b]today[/b]![/quote]

[quote][b]Is it really free?[/b]
Yes! We wanted to thank you, the players, for your support of the game. Whether you discovered it in the earliest days of Early Access or have dived into it within the past few weeks, your passion and engagement have been critical to helping us make the best game possible in [i]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/i].[/quote]

[quote][b]Where can I get it?[/b]
You can get everything on Steam today! Make sure you run the latest update and then simply click on the game’s Play button on Steam. Campaign 3 and [i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i] mode will update automatically.[/quote]

This release is exclusive to Steam for the time being, and will be released on other platforms in the new year. Until this new release is available on other platforms, you will only be able to cross play with other Steam players (on PC or Mac). Once the release is certified on other platforms, we'll post an update notifying you that full cross play functionality across all platforms will be restored (if you do play on other platforms, those platforms will still be able to cross play with each other during this period).

[h2]What Do I Get?[/h2]
There’s a ton of new stuff available. Let’s start with the new Campaign:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/fffd12e3521ed7aa9674537b2dda3325b35b1ccc.jpg[/img]
[h2]Campaign 3: [i]The Witch-king's Grasp[/i][/h2]
This all-new Campaign is set in a locale not yet explored within the game—Eriador. It’s our biggest Campaign yet, with 249 individual new Cards and over 20 new Locations (with over 300 cards included within the campaign)… and nary an Orc in sight! Instead, you’ll face a host of new Enemies—including 15 new Villains—across Bree, the Barrow-downs, and beyond. We’ll also introduce new mechanics to the game, including 3 new keywords and new Enemy behavior.

To aid you in your adventures, you’ll have access to 43 new Ally, Attachment, and Event cards. And let’s not forget your 4 new Heroes, available in their own Hero Packs: [i]Boromir[/i], [i]Frodo[/i], [i]Rossiel[/i], and [i]Sam[/i].
[img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/99453e86b9330567a6bd66eabb03e81f47fe365a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/65161a85f11edf0b6f76d298126b4453181a6a17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/a471d076e6275b06fe9359484715b579d363133c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/8b9a79597936698d63909afb2bed7d99c731b1f8.png[/img]

With new content comes new rewards. There are 5 new Quest Reward cards, 10 new avatars, and 4 new Hero Challenge cards for you to earn along the way.

Here’s a preview of the first Quest, [i]Burglary in Bree[/i]…

[quote]“Mr. Butterbur, sir!” Nob called breathlessly as he ran into the common room of The Prancing Pony. “There’s been another robbery, this time at the stables!”

Barliman ran out of the kitchen at the sound of Nob’s voice, his words rushing out in a torrent. “You don’t say! That’s a bad business, with all these black-hearted men about Bree. I do hope that Bob’s all right. Oh, but I forget he’s off helping his old nan so he wouldn’t be at the stables, would he?”

A gravelly voice spoke up from the end of the room. “A robbery, you say. Anything valuable taken?” This was Bill Ferny, who was hanging about more and more at The Pony these days, talking to all manner of folk at odd hours. Barliman did not like the man.

“It was a comb. Bob bought it from one of those men that’s always lurking about the town selling odds and ends,” Nob answered. “He asked me to check on it.” Bill surprised Barliman by slapping his hand on the table and shouting, “Skullduggery! I’ll post a reward for its return, myself.”[/quote]

Fraught with grave new perils and surprising challenges, [i]The Witch-king’s Grasp[/i] offers dynamic new gameplay opportunities and rich new experiences for you to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/df6e88bd7442717aebe740c8c5edee1046e7c13d.jpg[/img]
[h2][i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i][/h2]
This is an all-new game mode designed to challenge players in a single randomly-generated Encounter, where you’ll face a random setup of Minions and Villains drawn from across all our releases.

The [i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i] is a fast-play mode that you can play alone or with a friend. Players must first defeat a wave of Minions before confronting a final Villain. Each time you play, you'll be confronted with a different challenge, making the mode highly replayable. We can also expand this mode by adding new content with each new release we make.

Inspiration for this mode comes from within the pages of [i]The Lord of the Rings[/i] itself…

[quote]Down a long flight of steps the Lady went into the deep green hollow, through which ran murmuring the silver stream that issued from the fountain on the hill. At the bottom, upon a low pedestal carved like a branching tree, stood a basin of silver, wide and shallow, and beside it stood a silver ewer. With water from the stream Galadriel filled the basin to the brim, and breathed on it, and when the water was still again she spoke. "Here is the Mirror of Galadriel," she said. "I have brought you here so that you may look in it, if you will."
Gaze into Galadriel's mirror to see fates that may—or may not—come to pass.[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/21c5cfabf5e38def626c938f423caddbba7f7244.jpg[/img]
[h2]Campaign 2: [i]The Shadow's Fall[/i] is Also Free[/h2]
Finally, we have one last piece of news to finish up 2019. As of today, Campaign 2: [i]The Shadow's Fall[/i] is now fully free to all players! This makes the Tutorial Campaign and all three of available campaigns now part of the Core Set release. When you include the three additional Encounters, that's a total of 19 playable Quests plus the [i]Mirror of Galadriel[/i] playable to everyone!

Thanks again to all the players, and happy holidays!

—FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: News Update: December 2, 2019 — Release Plans Update
notes.notes:
Now that we've released [i]The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game[/i] on consoles and have made changes and improvements to fix the launch issues we encountered on servers, many of you have asked about our release plans for new content. We're here to answer some of those questions.

First, let's review the release schedule since early access launch on August 28th, 2018, and where we've come since then. As you know, we've been active with the game since that early launch, taking your feedback into account to help improve the game and bring it to where it is now. Here's what we've released since then:

[b]August 2018[/b]
• Early Access Game Release with [i]The Shadow's Reach[/i] Campaign
• [i]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/i] Soundtrack Release

[b]November 2018[/b]
• [i]The King of Carrion[/i] Encounter Release

[b]December 2018[/b]
• Vault (New Cards) Release

[b]January 2019[/b]
• Cooperative Multiplayer Added

[b]February 2019[/b]
• Vault (New Cards) Release

[b]March 2019[/b]
• [i]The Shadow's Fall[/i] Campaign (including 5 all-new Quests, 4 new Heroes and new cards) Release; re-balance of [i]The Shadow's Reach[/i]

[b]April 2019[/b]
• Emotes System and Ping Feature Added 
• Save Games for Single and Multiplayer Added
• [i]A Feast for Trolls[/i] Encounter Release

[b]May 2019[/b]
• Fully Revamped First Time User Experience Release
• All-new Tutorial Campaign Release with 1 new full Quest
• Card Rewards for Quests and Hero Challenges Added
• New Avatar Rewards and Hero Alt Art Added
• All-new Balancing System for Different Play Modes Added
• Second Multiplayer Play Style (Narrative) Added

[b]July 2019[/b]
• [i]Gundabad Awoken[/i] Encounter Release

[b]August 2019[/b]
• Full Release on Steam (end of Early Access)

[b]November 2019[/b]
• Release on Xbox One, PlayStation4 and Switch platforms
• Overhaul of Server System to improve stability

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
We had hoped to be able to talk about new content prior to this date, but our focus has been on releasing the console versions first, then gathering feedback from that launch to determine our future path.

So, while we're not yet ready to talk about release dates, we did want to give you some insight into what's on our immediate horizon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/1aff062e16b79c894628f29f2f90e6e9c4567801.jpg[/img]

[b]First up[/b] is Campaign 3: [i]The Witch-king's Grasp[/i], an all-new Campaign set in a location not yet explored within the game—Eriador. This is our biggest Campaign yet, with new Minions, Villains, Objectives, Hazards, and Locations. With the new Campaign, you'll also receive 4 new Heroes with which to build decks. Each new Hero comes with 4 brand new cards that we've talked about in past updates. In this Campaign, 
 
[i]The Witch-king's Grasp[/i] features 27 brand new Locations for your fellowship to visit. You'll see famous locales from [i]The Lord of the Rings[/i] as well as new locations as you uncover a dark plot that stirs the dark hearts of evil men who dwell in the Shadows of Eriador.

We will also introduce new mechanics to the game that will force players to rethink some of their deck setups to overcome the difficulties they face. There are 5 new Quest Reward cards, 10 new avatars, and 4 new Hero Challenge cards for you to earn along the way. 

The best part is that we're giving this Campaign to everyone for free! We'll discuss details when we make the release date announcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/df6e88bd7442717aebe740c8c5edee1046e7c13d.jpg[/img]

[b]Plus[/b], we're ready to unleash an all-new game mode: [i]The Mirror of Galadriel[/i] mode. Gaze into Galadriel's Mirror to see fates that may or may not come to pass. This new mode challenges players to a single randomly-generated Encounter where you can play alone or with a friend against a random setup of Minions and Villains drawn from across all our releases. 

This is a fast-play mode consisting of a single Location, where players must first defeat a wave of Minions before confronting a final Villain. Each time you play, you'll be confronted with a different challenge, making the mode highly replayable. We can also expand this mode by adding new content with each new release we make. We hope you enjoy this brand new way to play—as you never know quite what you'll face in the mirror’s reflection.
 
[i]The Mirror of Galadriel[/i] mode will also be free to all players and will be available as part of the Campaign 3 release. So, you'll not only get an entirely new narrative experience, at the same time you'll also get a robust new random mode.

[h1]Reminder[/h1]
One final note. We've mentioned this previously, but it bears repeating: while we will update news less frequently than previously, we are still working away feverishly on the game behind the scenes! Now that we have 5 platforms to support, we intend to slow our update pace in general on Steam. Of course, we will make new announcements when we have something we want to share. 

Additionally, we'll still monitor and participate in forums and will still be part of the Discord channel where we'll answer questions and discuss the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/e53a911e08db88f71947c2e0b9f5efd496ee029c.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your support of the game thus far and for our development efforts to bring Middle-earth to life. We hope you'll enjoy the new content we have planned and that the rest of 2019 is a very Merry one for you all.

Until the stars shine over our next meeting…
 
—FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Locations
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Freefolk!

From dark, cold, goblin-infested towers to enchanting sun-bathed riverbanks, [i]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/i] takes you to many places in Middle-Earth.
Here are some of the places we have visited so far:

The treacherous thin ice of the Sirros covers a massive tributary to the legendary river Anduin, up north:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/f0633fe4db36b13ab896ce0e618b0bb203b3bb6d.png[/img]

The beautiful but perilous Misty Mountains, inhabited by many creatures including the Stone Giants who regurarly battle against one another, creating thunderous noises earthquakes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/df3bad996c11f99146aeb15a3d996db685df7ac8.jpg[/img]

The gigantic gate of Gundabad, which was formerly a dwarven stronghold, now claimed by the Orcs...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/47f95941445e4b7b55d0205fdb6c254933e6cea0.png[/img]

... And the mines inside, crafted to perfection by the Dwarves who once lived there:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/f5a232083f91dbde0c675d20b6b74e71ed6714f8.png[/img]

But also the dark forest of Mirkwood and its voracious spiders:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/e26ae6ba4c3b7ac12afc5bf985804b70e2c1e93e.jpg[/img]

And, probably the darkest, most dangerous of them all, the mines of Nibin-dûm, filled with Goblins and Orcs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/f2cffa62be66c2111223f14ebd666e19c440c9bc.png[/img]

What is your favourite place in Middle-earth?
We would personally love to pay a visit to Lothlórien Elves or to have a pint of lager at the Prancing Pony!

notes.title: News Update — October 23, 2019 — The Faithful Servant
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/8eae841e7965143dd43c6897b30affec9ad89980.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]Cards of the Faithful Servant[/h1][/b]

Today we're going to take a look at the cards Sam, The Faithful Servant will be bringing with him into the Fellowship. Sam, one of the original Fellowship and Frodo's closest friend, is a Leadership Sphere hero that allows for strong board control to turn the tide of battle in your favor. As a reminder, all cards are subject to change before delivery subject to playtesting and licensor approval.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/0c48b565e03467ac9939a5380def1e5bf7bd3295.png[/img]

First off, let's take a look at Sam's Hero card and where he stands right now in development:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/8b9a79597936698d63909afb2bed7d99c731b1f8.png[/img]

Sam is a is a hearty Hobbit with a heart of gold, as a 10 threat Leadership hero his stats are:
[b]Attack[/b]: 2
[b]Willpower[/b]: 1
[b]Health[/b]: 9
Whenever Sam has [b]Guard[/b] active he will gain an additional point of attack, making him a great hero to protect your team. He also has a [b]Vanquish[/b] ability which will remove one resource from Sauron.

Let's take a quick look at the alternate art that Sam will have available for 1000 Fellowship Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/44c422dbb9c9c3fe5891565925d88f952550e390.png[/img]

[b][h1]--------------------------------------------------------[/h1][/b]

Now let's take a look at what kind of companions and tools Sam will be bringing with him. As a Leadership hero, let's take a look at that sphere card first:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/35045a5b6d300767db3a7535eaeeb87e1301f884.png[/img]
Bill is a level two Leadership card that will cost two resources to use, unless Sam is on the board!
[b]Attack[/b]: 1
[b]Willpower[/b]: 1
[b]Health[/b]: 5
[b]Trait[/b]: Animal
During each upkeep phase, Bill the Pony will provide you with an additional resource point, and he can be played for zero cost if Sam is already on the board.

[b][h1]--------------------------------------------------------[/h1][/b]

Now let's see what Sam has to offer for a Spirit Card:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/c32734510027ccb3fbccd627dc24d07f9eaf13c3.png[/img]
Gaffer Gamgee is a wiley level one Spirit Card Hobbit that costs a single resource to play.
[b]Attack[/b]: 1
[b]Willpower[/b]: 1
[b]Health[/b]: 2
[b]Trait[/b]: Hobbit
Using his Power, Gaffer Gamgee can be returned to your hand for the ability to exhaust a single enemy minion.

[b][h1]--------------------------------------------------------[/h1][/b]

If you're planning on running a Hobbit focused deck, Sam's Lore card is a strong choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/34b727a84402ee9a823ecbff9d9b5023945bfbd8.png[/img]
Nothing is more potent than a halfling's determination. Invigorate and restore four health to every Hobbit with this level one lore card that costs two resources.

[b][h1]--------------------------------------------------------[/h1][/b]

Lastly, let's take a look at the Tactic's card that Sam brings with him to the adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/1d5cdc189bf152bdeed1d61a781ecbfdfe9574ef.png[/img]
Use this level one tactics card to take control of the flow of battle for only one resource. Having the potential to reverse the tide of battle with this card will aid you greatly in your battles against the minions of Sauron.

This completes the list of cards available in Sam's Hero Pack.  We hope you enjoy these new cards in play when they are released.

notes.title: News Update- October 7th, 2019- Captain of Gondor
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/375cb93981589edb4fb05ec85b0d59a03ccb6557.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]Cards of the Captain of Gondor[/h1] [/b]
Today we're looking at the cards that will make up Boromir, the [i]Captain of Gondor[/i]'s Hero Pack. Boromir, one of the original Fellowship, is a [i]Tactics[/i] Sphere hero that reflects his status as a champion of Gondor. As a reminder, all cards are subject to change before delivery subject to playtesting and licensor approval.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/52c693714394df988c6934fdbb034b9d3c6b7a54.png[/img]
Let's start with Boromir's Hero card and it's current state in development:

[h1]Boromir[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/99453e86b9330567a6bd66eabb03e81f47fe365a.png[/img]
Boromir is an 11 Threat [i]Tactics[/i] Sphere Hero with the Gondor Trait. His stats are:
[b]Attack[/b]: 2
[b]Willpower[/b]: 1
[b]Health[/b]: 11
Boromir has a [b]Vanquish[/b] ability that allows him to Grant a +1 Attack and [b]Block[/b] to himself or another Character for the round. While the effects are only for the round, they are cumulative, so if you manage to get Boromir a second [b]Vanquish[/b] in a single round, he will get to target an additional +1 attack as well as grant and additional block.

Let's take a look at Boromir's alternative art, which you can unlock using 1,000 Fellowship.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/766220ef1a3197e94f54b3f0030e6bc7dde73e6e.png[/img]

Since Boromir is a [i]Tactics[/i] Hero, let's look at the Tactic's card from Boromir's pack first.
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Honor Guard[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/5ea42759fe07b3fb49b6a13ae9c20b14d800338d.png[/img]
This is a Level 2 [i]Tactics[/i] Ally with a Resource Cost of 2 and the following stats:
[b]Attack[/b]: 2
[b]Willpower[/b]: 0
[b]Health[/b]: 4
[b]Trait[/b]: Gondor
The Honor Guard grants [b]Block[/b] to 1 Character during each [b]Upkeep[/b] (at the beginning of a round).

Now, let's look at the [i]Lore[/i] card for this pack...

[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Heed The Dream[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/ead3f293cecded725abff821a875dabe32c6c0a0.png[/img]
This 1 Resource Cost [i]Lore[/i] [b]Event[/b] card Draws 3 cards from your deck, but at the cost of increased threat.

Next up, let's look at the [i]Leadership[/i] card in this pack...
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Knight Of The White Tower[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/b99b18508e130e02680c01b9f364551d65eeec36.png[/img]
This is 1 Resource Cost [i]Leadership[/i] Ally card comes with great power, but with great restrictions that will you will need to build around. He has the following stats:
[b]Attack[/b]: 3
[b]Willpower[/b]: 2
[b]Health[/b]: 6
[b]Trait[/b]: Gondor
With great stats, the Knight can add needed strength to just about any situation, but he may not use his Defense to activate [b]Guard[/b] and grants you +1 [b]Threat[/b] every time he attacks. You will need to be careful when and where you use him.

Finally, we wrap up with the [i]Spirit[/i] Card from the pack.
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Spear Of The Citadel[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/3dc59aecd55ea7625c2342ca528c96e634bf9153.png[/img]

This completes the list of cards available in Boromir's Hero Pack.  We hope you enjoy these new cards in play when they are released.

notes.title: News Update- October 1st 2019- Rewards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/6ea6435aef9270f161c87638ccc6c842be7ea442.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]Hail And Well Met![/h1][/b]
Last week we gave a sneak peek of Rossiel's upcoming cards, while this week we are discussing tips for new players, focusing on rewards and how to obtain them.

There are a number of ways of earning new cards and cosmetics in The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game. If you don't own our game, it's important to understand that this is not a free to play game. You get a base level of cards with the Core Set, and can then earn new cards just by playing the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/a2937771037cd34756f163b91514c43a1e2107bc.png[/img]
[h1]Fellowship[/h1]
The first method to earn new cards is to use Fellowship. This is earned simply by completing quests. You gain 1,000 Fellowship for completing a quest (and a smaller amount if you cannot complete the quest).

[h1]Quest Challenges[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/0426027e098323a571979b8cc68eb0800c3b0de5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/c113bf362db79685eba40c7461f29e951be2eb4f.jpg[/img][/url] [i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]
You also earn Fellowship by completing in-quest challenges. Want to know what challenges you need to complete in a quest? You can do this by clicking on the Rewards tab in the Play menu. Some challenges are the same between different quests, while other challenges are unique to each quest. You will gain a total of 200 Fellowship for each challenge you complete per quest for a maximum of 1,000 additional Fellowship.
[h1]_____________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Play Style Bonus[/h1]
You earn a 500 Fellowship Bonus for completing a quest in the Adventure Play Style.
You earn a 1000 Fellowship Bonus for completing a quest in the Challenge Play Style.

You can spend Fellowship on the following:
[list][*]Unlocking New Cards for your Decks
[*]Unlocking Alternate Art for your Hero Cards
[*]Unlocking Cosmetic Items from the Vault like Avatars, Player Name Tags, and Emotes
[/list] We've discussed how to unlock these items in previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/partnerevents/view_old_announcement/1583500109303753921]news stories[/url].

However, besides Fellowship, how else can you earn rewards? We covered a few methods in the previous news above, but let's go into more detail on specifics.
[h1]_____________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Hall of Heroes[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/c9a6d82a49cc10d0b301d46a376f2ec25c59dadf.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/857c27fa42dea4199e36a5ec83113ba09c8ab294.jpg[/img][/url] [i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]
Did you know that you earn a 500 Fellowship Award the first time you complete a quest with a hero? With 12 current heroes, that means you can earn 6000 Fellowship just by completing any individual quest with each Hero. To see what heroes you've completed in any given quest, just click on the Hall of Heroes Coin on the Rewards Tab.
[h1]_____________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Quest Completion Rewards[/h1]
Each time you complete a quest, you gain a reward, but the first three times you gain a special bonus beyond Fellowship.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/117a71d2b3d4552c89bc59dd6a6d5bb7216a708d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/dc5280bad7cd356b0fd68aea6e1450cada1dd571.jpg[/img][/url][i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]
[h1]First Time Completion - Quest Card Bonus[/h1]
The first time you complete a quest, you will earn a special card as a reward for its completion. You earn two of this card in your vault, fully unlocked for you to use. The exact card for each quest is outlined when you click on the First coin in the Rewards Tab.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/a0a7b5c6ec24954fdec4eae81c0458c43e83e428.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/fd370e3f8f704c6fca3cc70f3eb1428a6e1f9e33.jpg[/img][/url][i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]
[h1]Second Time Completion - Player Avatar Bonus[/h1]
The second time you complete the same quest, you will earn a special Player Avatar for you to use in both Single and Multi Player sessions. The avatar you earn is typically based on a character that appears in the quest and once earned, will appear in the Vault menu, fully unlocked. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/39385e48ff989ef51a1353bb9d5d9721cbdd2a9f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/8bad1603e87ba6bfc24507867c8db45811252d40.jpg[/img][/url][i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]
[h1]Third Completion - Trophy Avatar[/h1]
The third time you complete the same quest, you will earn a special Trophy Avatar that depicts one of the enemies you encountered during the quest that you may use as your Avatar in both Single and Multi Player sessions. Just like for Player Avatars, once earned, the Trophy will appear in the Vault menu, fully unlocked.
[h1]_____________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Hero Challenge Reward[/h1]
There's one other way to earn a new card that you might not know about. When you go to the Hero Detail screen in the Deck menu, you can change your Hero's selected art, but you'll notice a coin above the card on the left marked Hero Reward.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/1bbcb261fbce171ca9e7b00a3616f8a28cea4df8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/62b2b4fd63ce4e530c481d0f99a5460744d07100.jpg[/img][/url][i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]

This is the Hero Reward Card, which you earn by completing the Hero challenge. Every Hero has a unique challenge to earn their special Hero card. Simply click the coin to learn what each Hero's Reward card challenge is. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/2c0951058bbd9bf83f6d926753bd51a8de204bcf.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/09b75a33af8c3ffb55c626e035105ac1e1a31755.jpg[/img][/url][i]Click the image to see a larger version.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Obtaining Technical Assistance [/h1] 
If you happen to experience any issues or need technical assistance for the game, please remember that if you don't see the answer within the forums or on discord, you can always file a Helpshift here: 

https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/lord-of-the-rings-acg/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Discord[/h1] 
For more info on the game, there is a fan set up and run discord channel where you can reach out and talk to fellow players and look for multiplayer friends to play with.  

You can check it out [url=https://discord.gg/Nhrtbf4]here[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Twitch Stream Returning in November[/h1] 
Our Twitch Stream is taking the Month off for October. We'll post the next Twitch stream date when we return.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Next Update[/h1] 
That's all we have this week. Until we meet again, may the stars shine ever on your adventures! 

-FFI and Asmodee Digital

[b][h1]LOTR on Sale![/h1][/b]
As part of Asmodee Digital's Publisher Weekend, The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game is on sale from Sunday, September 29th through Monday, September 30th at 20% off!

Take up the challenge against Sauron in this single and two player cooperative PvE card game inspired by the original The Lord of the Rings™ Card Game by Fantasy Flight Games! Earn an additional 8 Hero Specific Reward Cards as well as 7 Additional Quest and Campaign Reward Cards for completing quests and campaigns or overcoming individual Hero challenges.

[b][h1]Cards of the Silvan Watcher[/h1] [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/e7d2c137f8aa298e83bc05140337a4d3ab000c1c.png[/img]
Today we will cover the cards that make up Rossiel's hero pack- The Silvan Watcher. Rossiel is a [b]Lore[/b] Sphere hero with a set of cards matching her status as an Elf from Lothlórien. As a reminder, all cards are subject to change before delivery subject to playtest and licensor approval.

Let's start with Rossiel's hero card, which we've updated since our sneak peek earlier this summer:

[h1]Rossiel[/h1]
Rossiel is a 9 Threat Lore Hero with the Silvan Trait. Her stats are:
Attack: 2
Willpower: 2
Health: 9
Rossiel's [i]Power[/i] allows her to recover a non-unique Hero and also to grant [i]Surge[/i] to your next ally played this round.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/a471d076e6275b06fe9359484715b579d363133c.png[/img]

Now, let's look at the Watcher's tactics card...
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Silvan Sharpshooter[/h1]
This is a 3 cost [i]Tactics Ally[/i] with the following stats:
Attack: 1
Willpower: 1
Heath: 4
The Sharpshooter is a Silvan trait card with Ranged who gets to make an attack on an enemy that is attacked by any other Silvan card.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/1a17c9197081dfcc6b91a57eb540279fc78d2808.png[/img]
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]None Return[/h1]
This is a 1 cost, 2nd level [i]Lore Preparation[/i] card that deals one damage to all enemies once an enemy defeated. If this results in another enemy being defeated, another damage is dealt, and so forth until either every enemy is defeated or no enemies are defeated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/acd8edc26c9ced8e93ae746f10bac8c64164f125.png[/img]
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]Greenwood Defender[/h1]
This is a 1 cost [i]Leadership Ally[/i] with the following stats:
Attack: 2
Willpower: 0
Health: 3
On arrival, this Silvan card gains Guard for free during the first round of play (though you will need to activate defense in subsequent rounds).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/0f8f9f970fcb039e19a85e1e1069e221d875add9.png[/img]
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
[h1]A Test of Will[/h1]
This 2 cost [i]Spirit Event[/i] grants a single non-unique Ally +2 Attack and +2 Willpower, but at the cost of that card gaining fleeting. This means you get a major stat boost, but that character goes away during the end phase. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/94c34814fa51acde45dee7b58cee9c606c2dce39.png[/img]

This completes the list of cards available in Rossiel's Hero Pack.  We hope you enjoy these new cards in play when they are released.

notes.title: News Update September 17th, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/2dacddbe69d16f32525ad3e46a91eb422c68e62b.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Tutorial[/h1] 

New to the game? If so, we highly recommend that you play the [b]Tutorial Campaign[/b]. If you are an experienced gamer, or are coming to us with a lot of specific card game experience, you're probably thinking, 'How hard can this be?", or you just hate tutorials and don't feel like you need the hand holding. We get it. That's why we broke the Tutorial down into separate quests that teach you the basic concepts and then let you put them into practice as you wish. We wrap that up with an original narrative story that nicely leads right into the first campaign. 

If you are used to lots of other card games, an important thing to note is that this is a Player Vs. Environment/Experience game, NOT a Player vs. Player game. That makes the experience very different than the typical digital card game and we have a very different complexity curve as a result. There are a lot of different options and nuances to the game that if you don't understand will hamper your ability to succeed against the forces of Sauron.  

Where can you find the tutorial? Just click on the green campaign icon on the Single Player game map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/ac0e064f36c4b9e2e544d81d11bbe6a392373f20.jpg[/img] 

To select an individual [i]Tutorial Quest[/i] (or any Quest), just click on the Quest icon to the right in the Campaign Information Screen. The first tutorial covers the basics of how to play the game, picking up where the basic prelude tutorial you played when you first started the game left off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/02fd77dc294ba39fc8f9bba5c58c800bfc4eb746.jpg[/img] 

[i]Tutorial Quest 2[/i] covers more advanced concept for the game, laying on top of the skills you learned in Quest 1. Here we introduce Fate and Threat, which are key elements to the game and absolutely vital to your success or failure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/1fe424229e958a54525870e3dc4a8536630d88ca.jpg[/img] 

[i]Tutorial Quest 3[/i] covers the most nuanced aspects of the game, but veteran players will tell you that mastering these skills are your keys to victory. We go over attachments, specific keywords and hand size limits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/407644b9fbd31cb4c751b3c7b9416dff3a7b6986.jpg[/img] 

[i]Tutorial Quest 4[/i] covers how to make your own decks and what cards go into them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/9ef950dbb5981f83744701aa941d1e69d8a70f1e.jpg[/img] 

Finally, we wrap it up with a standard quest in [i]Tutorial Quest 5[/i] for you to try out your new deck with, or to come back at any time. This Quest wraps up the narrative and directly leads into the first full campaign [b]The Shadow's Reach[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/8e491cbba078a23b062edd3b550270d158d32b2b.jpg[/img] 
[h1]______________________________________________[/h1] 
Did you know that you can also replay the Prelude Quest at any time? Need a refresher? Or just like honey? To replay the Prelude Quest, just click on the Options Icon from any screen and then click the Replay Tutorial button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31419660/dd9c56e4ff2075478a68645b5359e0f2d3a5e0fd.jpg[/img]

Frodo has the lowest threat of any Hero, but the lowest Health to go with it. However, he has Stealth, meaning that he can pick and choose when to act, and bypass guard to attack or resolve objectives. In this direct sequel to the events of The Shadow's Reach, your fellowship will delve deeper into Southern Mirkwood as you face off against wolves, orcs and the horrors that await you within Dol Guldur.

[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]

[h1]Early Access Ends Thursday [/h1]
Welcome to the Full Release of [i]The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game[/i]! 

This has been a fantastic journey as we emerged one year ago from our very own Bag End in search of adventure. Along the way we've encountered objectives to resolve, hazards to overcome and Sauron's minions to withstand ir order to exit our Early Access period today. 

If you have been with us from the beginning, you will forever hold a special place in our hearts. We thank you for your support and feedback and appreciate that you made it possible for this day to happen!

If you joined us along the journey, we thank you as well for keeping us going and for giving us your input in order to improve the game.

If you are new to the game, Welcome, Friend! Enjoy everything Middle-earth has to offer! We hope you will enjoy your stay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]Starting Tips for New Players![/h1]

Welcome to the game! 

We highly recommend that you start out by playing through the Tutorial campaign. Sauron is devious, and [i]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/i] can be complex and there are subtleties to the game that can escape you if you aren't prepared for them.

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[b][h1]Obtaining Cards[/h1][/b]
When you play the game, there are a number of ways to add cards to your deck.

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
The Core Set comes with 8 heroes:
[list]
[*] Aragorn
[*] Arwen
[*] Gimli
[*] Tom Took
[*] Dwalin
[*] Eowyn
[*] Faramir
[*] Legolas
[/list]
You can obtain an additional 4 heroes when you purchase the first Expansion, [i]The Shadow's Fall[/i].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/159cf82548eac2c775ea8e98986f6c3444415e59.png[/img]

This expansion includes 4 new Heroes:
[list]
[*] Dain Ironfoot
[*] Fredegar Bolger
[*] Glorfindel
[*] Idraen
[/list]
New Heroes will be released in future expansions.

[h1]Fellowship Cards[/h1]
You also have access to loads of cards to unlock using the Fellowship you gain by playing. To obtain these cards, simply go to the Decks menu...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5c7fe38921e2d1bae7eaca7b534c3687bdf383e9.jpg[/img]

...and select  the Cards tab:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e3363173d26c08471b37f6c8b9e79a6b05e29772.jpg[/img]

Select one of the grayed out cards in the gallery (you can use the filters to see only the cards you don't yet own in your collection) and choose the detail view by right clicking the card with your mouse. In the detail view you can select to unlock either a single card...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ae71cff5838f8a823f5338209482d4ca41895ed2.jpg[/img]

Or both cards at once using your in game Fellowship.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/3069520e3ae62bbcc77ec82f10a01483627d384e.jpg[/img]

Once you select how many cards you want, simply confirm to have these cards added to your collection. The amount will be deducted from your Fellowship total.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/cc62c3449425321f5632246caf20c87ac8bbeb85.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Note[/b] that you can only have up to two of each card in your collection (though once acquired, you can use up to two of each card in as many of your decks as you like).[/i]

You earn Fellowship every time you play, so if you run out of points, don't despair!  Just play a session or two and you should have enough to unlock more cards. You will earn some points even if you don't complete a quest.

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[h1]Quest Reward Cards[/h1]
You can also receive cards by completing quests. The first time you complete a quest or encounter, you will receive a new card as a reward for your efforts. (You will receive a new Player Avatar after completing the quest a second time, and a Trophy Avatar for completing the quest a second and third time respectively.)

In order to see what card a quest will grant you, go to either the Single or Multiplayer Play Menu and select the [i]Rewards[/i] tab... 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/489bf26ad6918ba5cb220254044cb5c2f5087661.jpg[/img]
 
...then select the [i]First Completion[/i] badge listed to see what card awaits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f83b78600dd6ba206f3fe705d937e758803b33ef.jpg[/img]

...and see the reward you will get when you complete the quest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/531010385f0994305c9487d9068147d098157d65.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Note[/b] that the reward will update to let you know what rewards you've already completed.[/i]

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Hero Awards[/h1]
Each Hero can also earn a new pair of cards for your collection by completing the challenge associated with the hero. To see what you need to do to earn the reward, go again to the Decks Menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5c7fe38921e2d1bae7eaca7b534c3687bdf383e9.jpg[/img]

Then select the hero you wish to examine by right clicking with your mouse on that hero...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/d80f5c5139f597c7743da4391bfb479876d9ab8d.jpg[/img]

Now select the Hero Award badge to see the card you can earn and how to earn it...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/06de158a146b854dd255dea967728fbc67a911be.jpg[/img]

You will need to track your progress toward these goals on your own, though the system will tell you once you've earned the reward associated with each hero. Each hero earns only one such card, but usually give huge benefits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Learning More About The Game[/h1]

If you want more hints, tips and suggestions on how to play the game, we recommend that you start with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/guides/]Guides[/url] section of the community hub right here on Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/74dacc8b3bee67211ada1fd141dc64091b5c5fda.png[/img]

There you will see walkthroughs, links to great videos and guides on how to build your decks. This area is fan supported, so feel free to include your own guides if you wish!

Beyond this resource, we also recommend the digital pages for the [url=https://digital.ringsdb.com/]RingsDB [/url]and [url=http://hallofbeorn.com/Digital]Hall of Beorn[/url] pages. These are fantastic resources created and maintained by fans and we appreciate and support the work they do!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Obtaining Technical Assistance [/h1] 
If you happen to experience any issues or need technical assistance for the game, please remember that if you don't see the answer within the forums or on discord, you can always file a Helpshift here: 

https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/lord-of-the-rings-acg/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Discord[/h1] 
For more info on the game, there is a fan set up and run discord channel where you can reach out and talk to fellow players and look for multiplayer friends to play with.   

You can check it out [url=https://discord.gg/Nhrtbf4]here[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Twitch Stream[/h1] 

Don't forget that you can check out our Twitch channel at https://www.twitch.tv/ffigames every two weeks at 1pm Central US time / 6:00pm UTC.  

Our next regular stream will be Wednesday, September 10th, though we will be having a special stream today with Asmodee Digital at 11am Central Daylight Time / 16:00 UTC to celebrate the official Full Release launch!  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Next Update[/h1] 
That's all we have this week. We will be back next week with more, specifically talking about all the rewards you can earn and how to earn them and how they differ from the cards you can earn via Fellowship. Until we meet again, may the stars shine ever on your adventures! 

-FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: News Update August 28th, 2019- End of Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/288acdd2567127cc3137d93d49f44bc5e7120dbc.png[/img]

[h1]Early Access Ends Thursday [/h1]
We will be bringing The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game into [b]Full Release[/b], Thursday, August 29th!

Final game pricing for the [b]Core Set[/b] will change to $19.99 in the US / €19.99 when this happens. (Actual pricing will vary per your local currency).

If you already own the game at any level, you already have the [b]Core Set[/b].

For new players, within the [b]Core Set[/b], you receive a Tutorial and Full Player Campaign, 3 Encounters, 7 Playable Quests, 8 Heroes, 37 player cards and the ability to unlock 53 additional cards using your Fellowship as well as free reward cards for completing quests and hero challenges.  

When we reach [b]Full Release[/b], every Core Set owner will continue to have access to new unlockable Player Cards, Encounters and the first quest of every future Campaign. Additionally, you will be able to access new cosmetics such as Avatars, Card Backs, and Emotes using your Fellowship Points that you earn in-game.

Additionally, after [b]Full Release[/b] we will continue striving to improve the game with general bug fixes, improvements to the user experience and quality of life additions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/a2937771037cd34756f163b91514c43a1e2107bc.png[/img]

[h1]Fellowship[/h1]
We've received a few questions on Fellowship. We will NOT be resetting your accounts or Fellowship totals when we come out of Early Access. You will retain the points you have received thus far and be able to continue to use them as normal with your existing totals.

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Additional Bug Fixes[/h1]
We will have one last game update delivered when we go Full Release on Thursday. At that time, we will also remove the Early Access pop-up menu that appears before you start the main menu. Take a moment to read it one last time, or for the first time if you clicked through it all this time without reading it.

We'll update you with a Full Release set of patch notes when this update goes live on Thursday.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img] 
[h1]Early Access Thank You![/h1]

To everyone who has played the game and given us feedback during the Early Access period, we want to thank you. Our development and publishing teams have a passion for this game and the world that J.R.R. Tolkien created and we hope that comes through in the work we have done and the work we will continue to do moving forward. We couldn't have created this game without you and your assistance.

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[h1]Exclusive Sauron Card Back[/h1]
As we mentioned last week, we wanted to give all Early Access players a token of our gratitude for being with us throughout this period. All Early Access players who purchase the game until Thursday 16:00 UTC (that's 11am Central Daylight Time) will receive this free gift, an exclusive Sauron Card Back- [i]Forged In Secret[/i] by our Art Director, Greg Shives.

[i]"Three Rings for the Elven-kings under the sky,
Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone,
Nine for Mortal Men doomed to die,
One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne
In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.
One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them,
One Ring to bring them all, and in the darkness bind them,
In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie."[/i]
[i][b]...The Lord of the Rings[/b][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e388d9792891168cd98c1fedea9dbe0ac25434b4.png[/img]

This card is exclusive to Early Access players and won't be available to anyone else after we go Full Release. This is in addition to any other exclusive content you might have received if you were one of our Founder's Pack players.  

[h1]_______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Don't Know How To Change Sauron's Card Back?[/h1]
As a reminder from last week:

In order to change Sauron's Card Back, you need to go to the Vault Menu from the Main Menu:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/c4797ba984c76b44dd79ef6f0e1e361ce3ca2ea0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/c30d70d04ea8679b73264fe3afcc1e7e7fc3291d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/707e1c4f6d19fe3c3d42dc25c4bb1a0597682f01.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7029cfd649b4a5e95973dc7b71eb52d8e8e7f08b.jpg[/img]

And then hit the save icon to save your selection (or hit the back button if you change your mind).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/fca6a8b9b2f7b399c4a2b93cfa03b5055054c16d.jpg[/img]

This week we continue on the road to Full Release on August 29th, one year since we released into Early Access.

Once the game is released out of Early Access, the final game pricing will change to $19.99 in the US / €19.99. This will be the final price for the Core Set (actual pricing will vary per your local currency).

Within the Core Set, you receive 3 Encounters, 7 Playable Quests, 8 Heroes, 37 player cards and the ability to unlock 53 additional cards using your Fellowship as well as free reward cards for completing quests and hero challenges.  

Beyond Early Access, every Core Set owner will have access to new unlockable Player Cards, Encounters and the first quest of every future Campaign, as well as new cosmetics such as Avatars, Card Backs, Emotes using your Fellowship Points that you earn in-game.

Beyond that, we will have new DLC Campaigns and Expansions and more to come. Once we release, we'll start highlighting these coming additions to the game.

Additionally, just because the game is going Full Release doesn't mean we will stop improving the game. We've already identified areas of the User Experience we'd like to further refine and we will of course continue to fix bugs and add both feature adjustments and quality of life improvements.
