notes.title: News Update August 13th- 2019 The Grand Adventure
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7690bcb8310f32c0c58ef0637ce9e086c904f281.png[/img]
[b][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/b]

Today we want to continue our discussion on the road from release to here, but before we do we wanted to announce that later today (sometime around 3:30pm Central US time, or 20:30 UTC), we will be releasing an important update.

This update fixes issues we've noticed since the release of Gundabad Awoken and carries over some of the minor fixes and optimizations we've made to the game in general as we build up to our console release later this month.  To read more about these changes, please look at the Release Notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/1639793203783629853/]here[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“It’s a dangerous business, Frodo, going out your door [...] You step into the Road, and if you don’t keep your feet, there is no knowing where you might be swept off to.” [/i]
[b]-The Fellowship of the Ring[/b][/h1]

Anyone who has ever worked on a video game knows that launch is a time of great nervousness on the part of creators. On one hand, you are incredibly excited about finally putting what is your creative baby in the hands of the public so they can see it first hand. On the other hand, you worry about every little thing—like the servers or game not working, or all manner of nightmare scenarios that run through your mind.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f1901ebe1892aa7419ad16c9faa2a52d6971f33d.jpg[/img]
[i](The Looming Threat Awaits...)[/i]

So it was with great anxiety and excitement that we launched The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game a year ago.  Both excited to see how fans would react and fearful that the entire endeavor would go 'poof' in our faces.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“It’s the job that’s never started as takes longest to finish.” [/i]
[b]-The Fellowship of the Ring[/b][/h1]

We launched into Early Access because we wanted to evolve the game with the feedback of fans. This is one of the great aspects of Early Access and we intended to embrace the spirit of it from the start by adding new features and content while utilizing the feedback of users to improve the game.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[b]Direct Impact[/b]

We received quite a bit of feedback from users right away and we began to apply it. There were a number of elements that made it into the game either right away or over the course of the following weeks and months, with just a few examples including:

[list]
[*]Changing the Business Model
[*]Dropping the Palantír as it was
[*]Adding Save Games
[*]Creating The New Tutorial Campaign 
[*]Individual Co-Op Features
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2ded290bf68af037a9df6e8a6fca346b4c6d3eea.jpg[/img]
[i](The reworked challenge screen, one element that arose due to your input)[/i]

Let's discuss each of them in turn:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“The world is full enough of hurts and mischances without wars to multiply them.” [/i]
[b]-The Return of the King[/b][/h1]

[b]Changing The Business Model[/b]

We're all gamers here at Fantasy Flight Interactive, and the greater discussion of the games industry and business models did not escape us. We began our game with a traditional free to play model but we struggled with what that meant and how it didn't really feel right for us. We changed the model over time to become more of a hybrid approach with less content being unlocked via what we then called 'Valor Points.'  As the game play changed further, this model made less and less sense to us and didn't feel right as part of our first release as a studio.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/640bdb8de695e9b79c2593d942288b1a0284d529.jpg[/img]
[i](An early hero pack purchase screen)[/i]

We announced our Founder's Packs with included amounts of Valor Points that we intended players to use to purchase available content on the first day. We didn't anticipate that many players would hold on to those points rather than using them to unlock the content as we intended. We received complaints from players with enough points to purchase all of the available content at that time, that we expected them to pay real world cash for that content—this was not at all our intention.

Based on this feedback we decided that the game was far better off using a model more similar to the original table top game, with a core game and additional content releases (which is more like the traditional video game model, expressed as a core game and DLC packages).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/15ae46b13d6630d2083971a9ddb60f6fbc9b7e98.jpg[/img]
[i](A later version of the Pack Unlock Menu)[/i]

We made immediate changes, giving away the full campaign as well as the initial hero packs and switching to a core set basis.  We let the Founders' Packs sunset and switched to the core game as it exists now. We also decided to release additional free and unlockable content to offset this change, including:

[list]
[*]Two Vault releases of 17 cards each
[*]Three Encounters 
[*]Alternative Hero Art
[*]Cosmetics
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]"The air seemed still and tense about him. At first the globe was dark, black as jet, with the moonlight gleaming on its surface. Then there came a faint glow and stir in the heart of it, and it held his eyes, so that now he could not look away. Soon all the inside seemed on fire; the ball was spinning, or the lights within were revolving. Suddenly the lights went out. He gave a gasp and struggled; but he remained bent, clasping the ball with both hands."[/i]
[b]-The Two Towers[/b][/h1]

[b]Dropping The  Palantír[/b]
The Palantír was meant to be a reward system for play. It didn't work. Despite the system only offering rewards that could be earned elsewhere, some players termed it a 'Loot Box.' No amount of communication changed this perception.  What's more, the rewards it offered didn't provide the reward incentive we intended.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/fbe56c9d066f304a13f173e68e88f96e346f8991.jpg[/img]
[i](Remember this?  We repurposed this sequence for the current rewards screen.)[/i]

We dropped the Palantír as it was, but laid the seeds of the reward system that was going to come in our major update in May. This included quest incentive rewards, hero rewards and in quest challenges.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“Well, I’m back.”[/i]
[b]-The Return of the King[/b][/h1]

[b]Adding Save Games[/b]
Another item we didn't anticipate was that individual game sessions would last as long as some players were taking. Last week we mentioned that the game began in a much more systemic fashion, with short, but very random play sessions.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1da3960a6bef9d7b1261f1718eac23cd02a52d9f.png[/img]
[i](Save games in MP)[/i]

With the drive toward a more narrative system with Fate and Threat events as part of the core experience, game sessions were taking longer. Most players were finishing quests within twenty minutes, but some took as long as an hour or more. This was exacerbated with co-operative multiplayer, where players typically obsessed over the best strategy to complete sessions, and with enemies having double the health.

For this reason we added save games for both single and co-operative multiplayer, which has been a great addition to the game, allowing players to rest up after each location and come back again.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“You are a ring-bearer, Frodo. To bear a ring of power is to be alone. The task was appointed to you. And if you do not find a way, no one will.”[/i]
[b]-The Fellowship of the Ring[/b][/h1]

[b]Creating The New Tutorial[/b]
While we announced right away from the start that the old tutorial was a placeholder, but we had originally intended only to release a new tutorial that was better than the first. 

After listening to users, we determined that the complexity of the game required more specific tutorials that aided a wider array of players. This lead us to break down the tutorial into discretely separate tutorials covering different aspects of the game and each building upon the other so that new skills were added and reinforced upon each other.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f06561c72d72fb74b8181c76047a6ea5e30943f4.png[/img]
[i]The Tutorial Quest Detail Screen[/i]

This also gave us the chance to move forward the Deck Builder Tutorial as well as to create a 'tutorial quest' where players could put all their skills together in a starter quest.  

Without your specific input on how to best craft the Tutorial, we would have not been able to deliver such a comprehensive new set of Tutorial Quests.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1][i]“I am looking for someone to share in an adventure that I am arranging, and it's very difficult to find anyone." 
"I should think so — in these parts! We are plain quiet folk and have no use for adventures. Nasty disturbing uncomfortable things! Make you late for dinner!” [/i]
[b]-The Hobbit[/b][/h1]

Co-Operative Features
Adding Co-Operative play was a blast for us as a team. While testing, we found that we were playing far more than necessary just to test because we were having so much fun just playing.  That's always a good sign.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/78b4c943d5498727578ddd6fd410fc0dd9b8256a.jpg[/img]
[i](A Cooperative Game Screen)[/i]

Despite how happy we were with how co-operative play turned out, you had some great suggestions that we brought to bear as soon as we could.

First, there were the aforementioned save games, but we also added new ways to handle individual cards (such as reward cards to only one player, while allowing other cards to be awarded to both).  We also initially designed the game with separate Fate meters, but quickly switched to a shared Fate meter based on your feedback.

We added Ping (have you tried it?  Just hit Control/Left Mouse Button (Cmd/Left Mouse Button on a Mac) in a multiplayer session so that players can indicate areas of the screen to one another in a session.

Co-Operative play started out good, but became even greater with the input of you, our players.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

That's it for this week.  Next week we'll discuss more aspects of the game since launch and a few other surprises we will announce...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Reminder: Obtaining Technical Assistance [/h1]

If you happen to experience any issues or need technical assistance for the game, please remember that if you don't see the answer within the forums or on discord, you can always file a Helpshift here:

https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/lord-of-the-rings-acg/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Discord[/h1]
There's a fan set up and run discord channel where you can reach out and talk to fellow players and look for multiplayer friends to play with.  

You can check it out [url=https://discord.gg/Nhrtbf4]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch Stream[/h1]

Don't forget that you can check out our Twitch channel at https://www.twitch.tv/ffigames every two weeks at 1pm Central US time / 6:00pm UTC. 

Our next stream will be tomorrow, Wednesday, August 14th. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
That's all we have this week. We will be back next week with more. Until we meet again, may the stars shine ever on your adventures!

notes.title: News Update August 6th, 2019: There and Back Again
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/8010394042fec382bbe8d7e3ee1d8cd62be9662d.jpg[/img]
[b][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/b]
Today we want to talk about the evolution of [b]The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game[/b], how it came to be and how we got to where we are now, but before we do, we have some news to share...

[b][h1]Full Release Now Set for August 29th[/h1][/b]
A few weeks ago we had announced that we were going to come out of Full Release on August 8th.  That's this Thursday.  We decided to delay that date as the console release has been slated for August 29th and we feel that it's important for us to coordinate between all platforms and to share the optimizations we've incorporated into the console versions of the game into full PC release, making the game more stable, smaller in size and with an increased frame rate.

We understand this will be frustrating to some, but we would prefer to delay the release slightly to ensure a more enjoyable experience for players at launch and to coordinate our marketing efforts so that they have the greatest impact across all platforms.  Prepare for a grand journey through Middle-earth where you can forge the new legend that will go down in the annals of history!

We'll have more to say about Full Access just prior to that date, so keep your eyes peeled for more in a future news update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[b][h1]The Road To Release[/h1][/b]
On August 28th, we released a game then known as [i]The Lord of the Rings™: Living Card Game[/i] from development onto Steam as an Early Access Game.  We called it a Living Card Game and released it into Early Access as our plan was not just release the game and then move on, but rather to treat it as a living entity that we would continue to develop, support and change over time with the help of you, the gaming audience.

Upon release, we had just the five quests of the first campaign, [i]The Shadow's Reach[/i], 31 initial player cards, and four hero pack expansions with another 16 player cards to unlock.  We hoped that from this humble beginning an audience would emerge and give us feedback to help us improve.  We got great feedback, some positive, some negative and some requesting new features or quality of life improvements.  We thank you all as you have been so great in your feedback.  You've had a huge impact on the game, and on our development team.

Since the time of that first Early Access release, we changed our sales model from a more complex free to play hybrid to a more traditional one that is closer in style to the table top FFG games you know and love.  We've also added a lot of new content including:
[list]
[*][b]Our first premium expansion[/b], [i]The Shadow's Fall[/i], with four new heroes, 16 new player cards and a whole host of new locations, encounters, hazards and enemies.  

[*][b]Three Free Encounters[/b], [i]The King of Carrion, A Feast For Trolls and Gundabad Awoken[/i], which are new quests balanced to be a bit harder than the standard quests.  Each of these new quests featured new locations, behaviors, enemies, hazards and objectives.  

[*][b]Two Vault Expansions[/b] with 17 new player cards each.  

[*][b]A Brand New Free Tutorial Campaign[/b] with an all new Free Quest [i]Flight Through Darkness[/i].  This tutorial walks you through various aspects of the game and gives you access to pre-constructed decks for you to use on your own adventures.

[*][b]A Revamp of the UX and First Time User Experienc[/b]e that adds new hero, quest and campaign rewards as well as new avatars, alt art for hero cards and quest challenges to achieve every time you play the game as well as save games for both single and multiplayer games.

[*][b]Co-Operative Play[/b], allowing you to play against Sauron with a friend and overcome his challenges and the ability to communicate through emotes. {We even added the ability to 'Ping' a player; just use Ctrl Left Click (Cmd Left Click on a Mac) to ping anywhere on the game surface.}
[/list]
There are now several hundred cards in the game with many more to come.  

On top of all that, we've added a variety of other enhancements—large and small—based on your feedback, as well as things we wanted to improve.  Though we intended to be just 3-5 months in Early Access initially, we feel that the changes and additions have been worth the time and made the game more robust, deeper to play and offered a variety of different quests for you to try and we don't intend to stop there!  
[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[i][b]If you haven't played in a while, we urge you to check out the game again. [/b][/i] It's very different (and we believe greatly improved) from the game we released just twelve short months ago.  We've evolved a great deal and will continue to improve the game, even after Full Release. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]A Hobbit's Journey[/h1]
Just like Bilbo took stock of his journey and wrote down his stories upon returning from his adventures to The Lonely Mountain, we've been on a long journey with this game and wanted to share some of its development with you.

While the game was first announced back on December 9th, 2017, and not released into Early Access until August 28th, 2018, the project existed long before either of those dates as various people and teams worked to come up with a way to bring a new Middle-earth card game adventure to the digital screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/0c1d65fcb4a7e6a440ea7f8057c905b513543f11.png[/img]
[h1]First Concepts[/h1]
Christian T. Petersen, company founder of Fantasy Flight Games and former CEO always had a strong passion for The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit.  Growing up, it was his favorite series of books, and Fantasy Flight Games has put out a number of games over the years taking place in Middle-earth.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/a24109c12fccc1ca10ea43d743022428a0e73d4a.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Work In Progress Prototype)[/i]

Nathan French, famed LCG designer at Fantasy Flight Games designed the original table top experience based on Christian's vision, which released in 2011.  Caleb Grace picked up the reigns and led the game through a fantastic run of expansions, nightmare decks, convention decks and scenarios and the full Saga mode.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/3aecaa733e223d2e5d82ca9241bb9233d81bde4b.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Work In Progress Prototype)[/i]

Way back in 2016, Christian asked the team at FFG, including Caleb, famed designer Corey Konieczka, current head of FFG Andrew Navaro, and VP of Interactive Keith Hurley to create a digital game inspired by The Lord of the Rings™ Card Game, and capturing the feel of it, but not a direct translation of the table top experience.  His vision was not to simply replicate the table top experience, or to compete or replace it, but to create a game unique in its own right but reminiscent of the table top experience and drawing up on the amazing art that game had accumulated over the years.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/561bbb09a8e2449f3520075e2d10b9e5bf8a1a3a.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Work In Progress Prototype)[/i]

They came up with a number of iterations on paper, exploring different concepts, but without a dedicated team, trying to come up with something they felt would meet their vision.  They went through a number of designs and proofs of concepts over about 18 months while also working on their regular projects.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/02411b215ee652942711a379aefad04ada569e89.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Work In Progress Prototype)[/i]

These early designs featured a number of approaches and layouts, and they created bare bones interactive prototypes of each, finding flaws and issues with them all.  After much trial and error, they came across the layout currently within the game, with one player at the bottom of the screen, another at the top, and Sauron in the middle, each laid out horizontally.  At this stage, the prototype looked like a very rough prototype of what we have today, but without a lot of the fine nuances that were to come.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[h1]Fantasy Flight Interactive Is Born[/h1]
By early 2017, the team at FFG decided they needed to take a different approach.  Though they had a working prototype, they realized that bringing that game to fruition and meet their vision would require a dedicated team who could devote themselves to it.  Christian reached out to an old friend, who had more than twenty years in the games industry making games of all sizes from massive AAA console games to the smallest games for the web and mobile phones, your humble writer.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bd8a9d1de8b83d784be0fb2a68992e281439797e.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Production Screenshot)[/i]

Christian is a great persuader, and the team at FFG are second to none.  I couldn't say no, and Fantasy Flight Interactive was born.  FFG brought us on board to shepherd the design that FFG had begun as well as to evolve it into a final project.  They also brought on the great development team at Virtuos Shanghai, and Caleb and I flew out to China to meet with them and kick off the project. Friendships were born, teams drew together, and the project took shape.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/12ebeeddbae482d436f6d545d9680ed1d8003111.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Production Screenshot)[/i]

With a small team in Madison, the support of the interactive team under Keith Hurley in Roseville, and the development team in Shanghai, we embarked on bringing The Lord of the Rings™: Adventure Card Game to life.  Asmodee Digital, already part of the Asmodee Games global group become the publisher, but also a partner as we worked to evolve the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ad32aefb9b2dd203de2ded22db958659fe739941.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Production Screenshot)[/i]

As a testament to this new influx of energy and focus, by November of that year we had a playable early draft of the game that covered the aspects of the original FFG design.  We set the announcement for December 9th and planned to release the game to the world in Early Access in late January.
[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]But wait...there's more![/h1]
We got to mid-January 2018 and had our initial Early Access Candidate nearly ready for launch.  We sat down with Christian and the FFG team one more time to evaluate the game and authorize for launch.  

At that time, there were was no Threat meter, no Fate bar, and the game played very differently.  The game played in a more truncated version of the cycle from the table top game.  You had a Planning Phase, an Adventure Phase, an End Phase, and an UpKeep Phase.  In Planning, you played all the cards you had resources for from your hand, and in Adventure Phase you played all of your cards you had played out to the table. At that time, you played all your cards, and then Sauron played all his cards.  

It was fast, but didn't feel like a game of reason and tactics.  You slammed Sauron, he slammed you back, and often it felt like back and forth punishment with your best laid plans thrown into disarray because you couldn't react, only play cards and hope.  All damage was reciprocal, so it hurt to attack just as much as it hurt to be attacked.  

The game was designed to be much more random, with the story serving only as a starting point and the card play being much more systems based and resulting in a very random experience from there.  If you are curious to see the game as it was played then, you might still find some of these early sessions from our Twitch streams on the internet.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1311b61dd2352bd088b7f1ba3f88be5948db16a9.jpg[/img]
[i](Early Production Screenshot)[/i]

Christian liked the game the game at that point, but felt it could be so much more.  Being such a fan of the books, he really wanted the narrative to be front and center, and wanted to refine the look of the cards further.  As much as it made the team groan at the thought of delaying, we agreed with the changes and collectively decided to delay the game to explore these features further and make these changes. We sat down with Corey and Caleb and Keith and rethought the game from top to bottom.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Once More Unto the Breach[/h1]
Over the next couple of months, the team went and made a host of changes.  First up, we went to an igo-ugo system. There was no more planning stage—you either played a card from your hand, or you played one of your cards already. This instantly fit better with our AI Sauron and made the game feel much more tactical.  Sauron could now react to you, and you could react to him.  

Since you couldn't play all of your cards at once, we had to tweak the numeric values of all cards, as they no longer made sense in a reactive play system.  

We refined this play for a couple of months and redesigned Guard about a dozen times, and added and removed universal reciprocal damage as well as changed a bunch of other parameters.  Each time we made a change, we'd have to sit down and play through the game painstakingly to review the effects as even small changes could have huge impacts on play.

Corey, Caleb, Keith and Christian spent many a day at our offices and theirs walking through these changes and making suggestions and playing through the differences. Somewhere in there we added threat events and then the full threat meter and expanded the scope of those events.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Economic Impact-[/h1]
Each of these changes created an impact on our business model for the game, and what had started as a fairly standard free to play model became a very complex hybrid free to play model.  This was something that we didn't account for fully at the time as we were more focused on the game mechanics, sowing the seeds of our eventual switch to a more traditional sales model post launch.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]
[h1]Not Quite...[/h1]
By now it was late June and we all felt we finally had the mechanics down, announcing an August 28th Early Access launch. However, in early July Christian called me one last time with a thought.  He felt that the game just wasn't quite there yet. He loved the mechanics and the balance was getting there (though he wanted it to be even harder to appeal to the hardest core table top gamers, and still does!).  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/288acdd2567127cc3137d93d49f44bc5e7120dbc.png[/img]

He still felt we had room for more narrative elements. Our initial campaign '[i]Wilderlands Adventure[/i]' we'd played to death on our Twitch stream, and despite the new mechanics, we still had room to bring the story to life in a richer way.  We had already delayed the game more than once, and I was adamant that we not do so again.  I had been through Early Access before, and wanted to get the game into the hands of the players to give us feedback as soon as possible, since we knew the game would evolve anyway.  However, Christian was right, and it was clear that there was more we could do. 

We had one last design session in mid July 2018 at our offices where Tim Cable, myself, and Christian dove into the game to craft the narrative focus you see today.  It was a testament to the editor and tools we had that we were able to add these elements quickly, and to the development team who were able to adapt so quickly to get these new features in before launch.

Several new features were introduced in that final month of development.  There was previously no way to do multiple narrative slides before and after a location scene, and we had no post game narrative screen, or any way to show narrative elements within a game location. Just prior to these changes, we had finally added the fate meter and fate events, but there was no way to make location specific threat or fate events.  We added all of these features in short order, and Christian brought out all of his reference books, maps and resources to personally draft a new story that was worthy of a Middle-earth adventure.

There were some changes to characters, too.  We wanted Bilbo to be part of the story in a more active way, and to bring in some other notable characters from the books for players to related to.  We wanted our starting heroes in the core set to be more appropriate to the time period.  Out were [i]Frodo[/i] and [i]Sam[/i] (though they will be back later), and in came [i]Tom Took[/i] and [i]Dwalin[/i].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ca10afc899830e8917800f982ae58106a450326e.jpg[/img]

We had a lot of fun putting together the final campaign elements.  Christian wrote the narrative for [i]The Shadow's Reach[/i] (and had so much fun he also wrote the narrative for [i]The King of Carrion[/i]), acting out all of the parts for us and taking our feedback (he does a killer Gollum by the way).

Keith and Corey gave us further feedback as we went, and Keith pulled together all of the voice actors in short order to deliver amazing performances (to this day I don't know how he does it so quickly with such great reads by the actors).  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/c10ad84517d8804fba9b98f7c5b2750f90c3dae2.jpg[/img]
[i](Almost There!)[/i]
The net result was a more evocative, more exciting and much more narrative game for release. The game had fully transformed from a more systems driven random game to a more immersive story driven game but with the ability to replay that story with new heroes, new cards and retaining the deck building aspects that we wanted to be a centerpiece of the challenge.  The rest, as they say, was history- which we will cover a future news update...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/57a99bdaca493c8e8ab44e11a33122e532504752.jpg[/img]
[i](The Game Today)[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[b]Answers to Frequently Asked Questions[/b]
We get a number of questions here and on the discord channel, and we wanted to answer a few that come up frequently:

[i][b]What else are you working on?[/b][/i]
Once we are in Full Release and have been able to sync up releases on all platforms, we will be making a comprehensive review of our content and deciding what is next.  People have asked for a number of features, and we have to weigh what is easy to make and what is not, and what we can delivery quickly vs what will take a longer period of time.  

Additionally, we want to provide other ways to expand the game content as well as more ways for you to spend that hard earned Fellowship.  We have a number of concepts in the works, but we have to evaluate their feasibility before we make any announcements.

[i][b]When will you add more languages to the game?[/b][/i]
We have a number of languages we want to add to the game, but it comes down to expense and time.  We're evaluating these now and will make an announcement in the near future.

[i][b]Will you be able to cross play between platforms?[/b][/i]
That's the plan, each console platform willing.

notes.notes:

[b][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/b]

[h1][b]Gundabad Awoken Releases Today![/b][/h1]
This afternoon US time (late evening European time) we will release Gundabad Awoken for you to play.  This free Encounter gives you the chance to explore the ancient home of [i]The First Forge[/i], now overrun with Goblin hordes.  

We hope you enjoy this new adventure!

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Along with this new Encounter, there are a number of fixes and adjustments.  You can learn more about these over at the latest [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/2944710017720577759/]Patch Notes[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1]Gundabad Awakes![/h1]

Legend holds that in the distant mists of the First Age, Durin, father of Dwarves, built his first forge within Mount Gundabad. Alas, in time Orcs seized control of the mountain stronghold. Though the Dwarves drove them out repeatedly, the Orcs always returned. Even unto the current times of the Third Age, their foul presence remains a constant blight upon the Dwarves' sacred place. 

The threat of Orcs—and worse—is on the rise once more. Reports claim that Gundabad swells with increasing numbers of Orcs, evil Men, and other miscreants. The corrupted fortress stirs with renewed purpose… though to just what purpose remains a mystery. Heroes are needed—brave souls who will venture to this desolate place and discover what draws forth the minions of darkness.

In this Encounter your Heroes are faced with a mystery: many Orc factions, as well as evil Men from Carn Dûm and Rhudaur, assemble within Gundabad. Someone—or something—calls to them, but to what purpose? To learn the truth, stealth and guile are called for. Your journey to Gundabad is a search, not an assault. You must use disguise and subterfuge to infiltrate the enemy stronghold and glean its secret, but that's only the beginning! To find the source of the dark siren song, you'll need to navigate the depths of the labyrinthine mountain fortress. Should you overcome the obstacles along the way, you'll face a foe unlike any you've encountered before. 

Choose your deck carefully, for you'll need both wits and combat prowess to defeat the foul power that rouses Mount Gundabad and its denizens.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

In a previous news update, we previewed a few new Goblins.  In [b]Gundabad Awoken[/b], you will need to infiltrate the mountain in disguise, and might have to rely upon the assistance of Goblins to complete your quest.  Depending on how you proceed, you might face these Goblins across the field of battle, or, relying on your disguise, make use of these Goblins to proceed.  Let'd compare these Goblins, both as Allies, and as Enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/cd90acf98b9c1160c41315cdd7feb700f167891f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ca6bcad2a079a80fa7c31e5cf14bc1c9dfeed0a3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/83b77f12614fe5ebfabf42f7aaf2f29ddff340bc.jpg[/img]
[b][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/b]

[h1]Sauron Gains New Abilities[/h1]
Let's continue our sneak peek at Encounter 3 this week.

Up until now, Sauron's ability to deal with the player has been pretty fixed (outside of new enemies and hazards) while the players have enjoyed many new cards and tactics to use against him.  Starting with Encounter 3, that's no longer the case and we will be adding even more cards for Sauron as we move forward.  We've been working on new Shadow, Treachery and Event cards for Sauron to use against your fellowships.

Keep in mind that these are all works in progress, and we reserve the right to change these cards up until release.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

Let's take a look at two of Sauron's new Shadow (attachment) cards...

[h1]Dark Defense[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/02796efc7bb0436e5f95330457e0f3d54bc0cb98.png[/img]
This Shadow card costs Sauron just a single resource to give an existing card Guard.  While Sauron can't turn on Defense like players, this card gives him a similar ability for the cost of a resource.

[h1]Going For Help[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9f078c105e2b9ea7c41fdc5146b612149103e4ce.png[/img]
This Shadow card card costs Sauron nothing, but makes one of Sauron's cards fleeting.  If that enemy is not defeated before the end of the round, they will disappear, but be replaced by three random enemy minions in its place.  

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

Now let's look at a pair of new Event cards...

[h1]Dark Recovery[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ed12b0a1cb8b5cbef8d0e1ad1c08f63beca73c39.png[/img]
This 2 resource cost event will heal a random enemy 2 Health and then ready that enemy card.  This give Sauron the ability to ready any enemy to act again if he's willing to trade resource points to do so.


[h1]Sap Strength[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9cd470695267945db4dc212a1447f449a30a7300.png[/img]
This devious single resource cost card will reduce a random Hero or Ally with at least a 2 Attack value by 2.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
Just as a reminder, we have some other updates coming along with Encounter 3...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f06561c72d72fb74b8181c76047a6ea5e30943f4.png[/img]
[b]Deck Builder Tutorial (Quest 4) Restructure[/b]
While we are very pleased with most of the new tutorial structure and how it better prepares you for the complexities and subtleties of our game, we felt that the Deck Builder Tutorial (Quest 4) just didn't hit the mark.  We have a new version of this almost ready to test internally that we feel does a better job of walking you through the options of building a deck as well as reinforcing concepts like Sphere Levels and better explaining the ins and outs of deckbuilding in a more sandbox type of environment.  

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1da3960a6bef9d7b1261f1718eac23cd02a52d9f.png[/img]
[b]Save Game Changes[/b]
We're making some under the hood changes to the save game system that we feel will improve that system.  Currently, when you have a save game, whatever deck you were using locks out the deck from editing.  You cannot change the associated deck until you either finish the saved game or opt to delete it.  

We've decided to remove that restriction.  When you make a save game, it will save a version of that deck with the save so that when you run a saved game, it will contain the remainder of that deck in the save.  This will allow you to manipulate the associated deck separately from that saved game.  However, when you run that saved session, you will still have the deck you used from the original game.

[i]Why don't we allow you to bring the altered deck to the saved session? [/i] Since a deck lasts across an entire quest, there's no way for us to know what cards would have been used in an altered deck up to the point of the save.  You are saving the state of the session as it existed at the time, so we save the deck as it existed at that time.

This will clear up some issues with both single and multiplayer save games and make it less confusing when you go to make changes to your decks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]

[b]Steam Outage This Past Weekend[/b]
There were Steam outtages this past weekend, especially in Europe.  We apologize for this issue, though if Steam is down, there is little we can do on our end.  If you are still experiencing issues, you can post us a helpshift ticket as mentioned below and we will look to see if there are solutions we can bring to bear.

Our team is currently focused on Encounter 3: [i][b]Gundabad Awoken[/b][/i] and our upcoming Console release, so we're heads down at the moment.  However, we do have sneak peeks for you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]The Goblins Arrive![/h1]
Last week we shared a bit of info on the hordes of goblins in the upcoming Encounter. This week, we're going to give you a better look at the upcoming enemies you might face once you make your way to Gundabad.

[b]Pit Goblin[/b]
Let's start with this creature of Gundabad.  He doesn't have staying power, but he hits hard.  If you manage to remove him from the board, however, he will give you a resource.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ca6bcad2a079a80fa7c31e5cf14bc1c9dfeed0a3.png[/img]

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Gundabad Elite[/b]
This elite goblin has staying power, a decent punch, and both [b][i]Ranged[/i][/b] and [i]Stalwart[/i] to trip up your Fellowship.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/91613e2ba435885e407d4f0442767e395191c7e6.png[/img]

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Goblin Tribe Chief[/b]
This tribal chief hits hard, sticks around and has Stalwart, but is at least is balanced by the fact that he is Fleeting, though if you don't defeat him before he departs, he will summon 3 [i][b]Orc[/b][/i] Minions to take his place.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9859ee00750215e481e5cd48acf533778e7568b7.png[/img]

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Goblin Sneak[/b]
The sneak is particularly nasty, since if he hits you, he uses a new game element—[i][b]Shed[/b][/i]—which is causes you to lose the top card from your deck if he manages to hit you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/545b2cc01b84ab6552d60a407fe3b47ea29ae257.png[/img]

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Goblin Runner[/b]
The runner is a minor minion of Sauron, though if you allow him to stick around he'll summon friends to join him.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/4a890840eb758fa1564adc73ff5818c500e20f22.png[/img]

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Goblin Driver[/b]
Last but not least, we bring you the new Goblin Driver.  He is a taskmaster, who readies a random exhausted Orc when he arrives, but does 1 damage to it with his nasty whip.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1ff4451b203a8aa217cc99bc343b336595111890.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]

[h1]General News[/h1]
A few weeks ago we discussed the upcoming Full Release on Steam coming August 8th, as well as some upcoming changes to the game such as new Save Game behavior and a new Tutorial Quest 4 (Deck Building).  You can read more about that in the original news story [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1584619034853027575]here[/url]. 

The changes are in testing currently and will be rolled out when we roll out the next Encounter—Gundabad Awoken—later in July so that we can resolve any issues with this rollout before we go to the Full Release.

Additionally, you may have noted that we've updated the Steam Store description for the game.  We hope you like the changes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Sneak Peek: [b]Gundabad Awoken[/b][/h1]
Let's take a deeper look at [b]Gundabad Awoken[/b], the free new encounter coming in late July.  This new encounter takes place in the hills and mountains near Gundabad, and we've crafted all new locations in which you will be adventuring.

[b]Hold Back The Horde![/b]
One of the new features in [b]Gundabad Awoken[/b] is the “Horde” objective. Now, we can’t give away too much of how or why you might encounter it, but we can talk a little bit about what it does and why.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f7a7e78f2dae33eaa47f318da0d6bcc0569cc7fa.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f6abe4455fb7faca5a24c6ed8268aa37e29434ff.png[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the image to see it full size...)[/i]

Locked and Timed with a Bolster frame in this case means that each round the value of this objective will increase by one to reflect the growing hordes of Sauron’s minions that bear down upon you.

The Upkeep ability is where we are trying something a little new. This card will pull from a random pool of effects, with each point of value on the objective being an extra roll of the dice. If you let this effect stick around for too long, you will be overwhelmed by its effects.

Here are a few examples of things that this Horde might to do you…

[b]1.	All Enemies gain +1 Attack for this round
2.	Summon an Enemy from a random pool of choices
3.	Sauron gains +1 Resource[/b]

We have more than these available to us, but this is just a taste of what you can expect in Gundabad Awoken. We wanted to create a new experience with our third encounter, since encounters allow us room to challenge both ourselves as designers and you as our players. We look forward to seeing what you make of it.

[h1]______________________________________________________________[/h1]

[b]Locations[/b]
The first location we want to share with you is part of the Mine of Gundabad, which is currently controlled by hordes of Orcs.  

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/03673ea9d7f6eb75584090da11982e96fc3c7fe1.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/db06cf3e26a532428258c060b9934e8a959e201c.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the image to see it full size...)[/i]

This next location is deep within the mines of Gundabad where the Dwarves of old once forged mighty works.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/44e89270d75684c4ea50ed2ebc8c937a20abd7d0.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/14bbd1c9aef26e002833029749a8dfc01e2e2a79.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]

[h1]Sneak Peek: [b]The Witch King's Grasp[/b] Heroes[/h1]

A few weeks ago, we gave a sneak peek of the upcoming Hero releases for Campaign 3: [b][i]The Witch King's Grasp[/i][/b]. This week we want to show you the actual cards. Though we are still a ways out from the launch of this expansion, and these cards are a work in progress subject to play testing and balance, we wanted to give you an early view of to the upcoming content as we get closer.

Let's start with [b]Boromir[/b], a Tactics Hero of Gondor. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2df9ebf35f4331dfa59f9eb759fa4fc35eb82753.png[/img]

Whenever Boromir defeats an enemy, he may grant every other character +1 attack or Block for the current round.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]

Next, let's examine [b]Frodo[/b], a Spirit Hero of The Shire.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/65161a85f11edf0b6f76d298126b4453181a6a17.png[/img]

He is a hero with Stealth and a new keyword; Achieve. Achieve is a bit like Vanquish, but for resolving Objectives. Whenever Frodo resolves an Objective, he gains +1 resource.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]

Our third hero is [b]Rossiel[/b], a Lore Hero from Lothlórien. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9ada75080248d06807d0a9c9ecbf80f9a335188c.png[/img]

Rossiel can use her power to recover 1 of your non-unique Allies, drawing them from the playing field back to your hand.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]

Our final hero is [b]Sam[/b], a Leadership Hero and faithful friend from The Shire.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9e129702ffed4ddd9fec7f7225c4c89a7d1eee8c.png[/img]

Sam has a higher attack when he has an active Guard. He also steals a resource from Sauron whenever he defeats an enemy. 

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]

Keep in mind that these stats, threat levels and powers can—and likely will—change once we have these heroes in testing. However, you can start imagining deck strategies with these heroes included in the mix.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

notes.title: News Update June 18th, 2019 — Full Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7690bcb8310f32c0c58ef0637ce9e086c904f281.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1]

[h1]Full Release Date Planned for August 8th[/h1]

We are pleased to announce that we will be coming out of Early Access into full release on August 8th!  

We've had an amazing year listening to your feedback and using it to directly improve your gaming experience in Middle-earth.  We feel that the time has come, however, to take the game from Early Access to Full Release.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]History[/b]
We've come a long way since August 28th of last year in how the game plays and have added a lot of content along the way.  We've added 34 individual new Vault cards, two free encounters, a whole new Tutorial campaign, and a host of new features since then, not to mention a second DLC campaign.  We couldn't have done this without your support and feedback.

We had originally intended to be in Early Access for only about 5 months, but when we changed over from a free to play model to a premium experience back in September based on user feedback, we also made the choice to also revamp a number of systems, overhaul the UI and add new features such as the Save system and give you additional free content along the way.  

Though we have a few new items coming before the August 8th date, we feel that the time is right to make the switchover.  The annoying Early Access banner will go away and we'll shake off the training wheels to support the game with new content.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]What Will We Be Doing Until Full Release?[/h1]

We haven't been idle since we made the big recent update to the game's UI and systems.  Before we release, we intend to make the following changes:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f06561c72d72fb74b8181c76047a6ea5e30943f4.png[/img]
[b]Deck Builder Tutorial (Quest 4) Restructure[/b]
While we are very pleased with most of the new tutorial structure and how it better prepares you for the complexities and subtleties of our game, we felt that the Deck Builder Tutorial (Quest 4) just didn't hit the mark.  We have a new version of this almost ready to test internally that we feel does a better job of walking you through the options of building a deck as well as reinforcing concepts like Sphere Levels and better explaining the ins and outs of deckbuilding in a more sandbox type of environment.  This update will be made before we go into Full Release so we have time to do any final fixes.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1da3960a6bef9d7b1261f1718eac23cd02a52d9f.png[/img]
[b]Save Game Changes[/b]
We're making some behind the hood changes to the save game system that we feel will improve that system.  Currently, when you have a save game, whatever deck you were using locks out the deck from editing.  You cannot change the associated deck until you either finish the saved game or opt to delete it.  

We've decided to remove that restriction.  When you make a save game, it will save a version of that deck with the save so that when you run a saved game, it will contain the remainder of that deck in the save.  This will allow you to manipulate the associated deck separately from that saved game.  However, when you run that saved session, you will still have the deck you used from the original game.

[i]Why don't we allow you to bring the altered deck to the saved session? [/i] Since a deck lasts across an entire quest, there's no way for us to know what cards would have been used in an altered deck up to the point of the save.  You are saving the state of the session as it existed at the time, so we save the deck as it existed at that time.

This will clear up some issues with both single and multiplayer save games and make it less confusing when you go to make changes to your decks.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Bug and Stability Fixes[/b]
We have a few more bug fixes and stability enhancements we're putting into the game to reduce connection issues and fix stability further.  

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Performance Enhancements[/b]
Our new technical art director has been unleashed on the game to optimize and he's found a number of ways for us to gain performance improvements.  We've been busily optimizing each of the game locations as well as the card frames and UI elements and this will improve performance on all platforms. 

Currently the game uses numerous dynamic lights and multiple layers within textures as well as complex shaders and particle effects.  We've found a number of efficiencies that we can apply to each of these which allow us to retain the visual fidelity but improve the frame rate across the board.  This will be coming before we go to full release. 

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]A Brand New Encounter 3[/b]
As mentioned last week, we will be releasing the free Expansion, Gundabad Awoken.  This all new 4 location quest will test your heroes as they uncover the mysteries of Gundabad and its relation to Carn Dûm.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]What About After Full Release?[/h1]
Full Release doesn't mean we won't be further enhancing the game.  We intend to continue to implement updates and make further refinements to the game as we move forward.  We have numerous UI enhancements and improvements as well as new content and features that we want to take live after Full Release.  We'll continue to listen to your feedback and work with you as we have since launch to improve and add to the game. We will continue to regularly update with new content as well as provide live support from our team after we go into Full Release. 

Additionally, we've already announced our next campaign expansion [i]The Witch King's Grasp[/i], which we intend to add as DLC after we go into Full Release.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Discord[/h1]
There's a fan set up and run discord channel where you can reach out and talk to fellow players and look for multiplayer friends to play with.  

You can check it out [url=https://discord.gg/Nhrtbf4]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch Stream[/h1]

Don't forget that you can check out our Twitch channel at https://www.twitch.tv/ffigames every two weeks at 1pm Central US time / 6:00pm UTC. 

Our next stream will be Wednesday, June 19th.  We'll be discussing upcoming content, the name change and give you some behind the scenes discussion about the changes we will be making about the stability enhancements we've done and will be doing for Full Release.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
That's all we have this week. Until we meet again, may the stars shine ever on your adventures!

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/673c859677941e8a471e8ec7b0f0b94a237962e8.jpg[/img]
[i][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/i]
[h1]Branding Change[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e30df4742a0bf839dc63225f9ee2a5dd2d210383.png[/img]

As we announced in the news on Friday, we have decided to rebrand the game as The Lord of the Rings™️ Adventure Card Game as part of our build up toward the Full Release out of Early Access and our console release later this year. 

We'll provide an updated build later this week to bring the game into line with this change.    
  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Mount Gundabad Awoken Encounter Coming July 23rd![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/6ad1cd0943e1a9b9842d3e8b010bc19aa3bfb1f6.jpg[/img]

Our next content release will be an all new Encounter provided free to all users.

[b]Legend holds that[/b] in the distant mists of the First Age, Durin, father of Dwarves, built his first forge within Mount Gundabad. Alas, in time Orcs seized control of the mountain stronghold. Though the Dwarves drove them out repeatedly, the Orcs always returned. Even unto the current times of the Third Age, their foul presence remains a constant blight upon the Dwarves' sacred place. 

[b]The threat of Orcs[/b]—and worse—is on the rise once more. Reports claim that Gundabad swells with increasing numbers of Orcs, evil Men, and other miscreants. The corrupted fortress stirs with renewed purpose… though to just what purpose remains a mystery. Heroes are needed—brave souls who will venture to this desolate place and discover what draws forth the minions of darkness.

[b]In this Encounter[/b] your Heroes are faced with a mystery: many Orc factions, as well as evil Men from Carn Dûm and Rhudaur, assemble within Gundabad. Someone—or something—calls to them, but to what purpose? To learn the truth, stealth and guile are called for. Your journey to Gundabad is a search, not an assault. You must use disguise and subterfuge to infiltrate the enemy stronghold and glean its secret, but that's only the beginning! To find the source of the dark siren song, you'll need to navigate the depths of the labyrinthine mountain fortress. Should you overcome the obstacles along the way, you'll face a foe unlike any you've encountered before. 

[b]Choose your deck carefully[/b], for you'll need both wits and combat prowess to defeat the foul power that rouses Mount Gundabad and its denizens.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

notes.title: Understanding the Power Behind a Name
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e30df4742a0bf839dc63225f9ee2a5dd2d210383.png[/img]
[h1]Hail and well met![/h1]

Today we have a fairly large announcement that we're excited to be making to continue to better align with the goals and desires for this digital card game that has been evolving since we launched into Early Access. Early Access has been a series of improvements and adjustments based on the communities feedback and this change that we are announcing today continues that tradition.

Henceforth from this date we will be changing the name of "[i]The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game[/i]" to "[i][b]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/b][/i]". Now that the big announcement has been made, let's go over some of the reasoning behind this so that you can all understand why we're making this change.

While the term "[i]Living Card Game[/i]" is used in the physical card game world to represent an ever-growing TCG world filled with narrative stories and campaigns, this is not a terminology regularly used in the digital realm. As such we feel that the name "[i]Adventure Card Game[/i]" better describes our core value and game design that revolves around a card game in which you adventure throughout the world creating your very own story in Middle-earth. This means that the name now represents something more understandable for the entire community, as well as better representing the full experience offered by the game.

This change is been something we have been longing to do thanks to your feedback that you have generously been providing since release. We hope that the you like the new name, [i][b]The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game[/b][/i], and that it better meets player's expectations for the experiences they will face as they travel in Middle-earth.

Asmodee Digital and FFI

notes.title: News Update- May 7th, 2019- Play Balance
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/23e7320aea8bbcbc2752c847c07dfd41da341871.jpg[/img]
[i][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/i]
Just a reminder that one week from today, we will be releasing our major new update with all of the changes outlined above and more.  The update will be completed by 10am Central US time (UTC -6), so you may have trouble connecting as the update is underway on the servers in the hours prior.  Please make sure the game is fully updated before launching the game to check it out, and as always, if you have any issues, please submit a helpshift ticket at LINK.

This is a major update touching many areas of the game and we've outlined the nature of these changes over the last several weeks.  However, in case you missed them, you can read more about these changes at the following links:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/2565272236259813726]Deck Building[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1760253077622761448]Save Game Feature[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1790650665579415023]Tutorial Changes[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1795154707159190650]Scoring and Rewards[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1716342347275449784]Cosmetics[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1624021088655683658]Campaign Challenges[/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Play Balance[/h1]
This week, we continue our series of articles about the coming update as we focus on our new play balancing tools and how they will affect play.  As you may recall, we delivered an initial play balance of the first campaign when we released Campaign 2.  That was merely a foretaste of the changes we will be implementing moving forward.

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]A Better Mode of Play[/b]
Our goal with the difficulty settings is to move to a more distinct play style rather than just differences in difficulty.  For casual fans, we wanted a mode that was more focused on narrative progression and drop in play.  For players who are veterans of the table top game, or who are die hard digital card game fans, we wanted to increase the challenges to overcome.  That leaves Adventure as the standard mode of play, with challenges aplenty but without the truly difficult challenges of the harder mode.

Thus we went from our previous Easy, Normal, Hard difficulty designations to Narrative, Adventure and Challenge modes of play.  However, to realize this design fully, we needed a better set of tools, and that meant overhauling how adventures were designed.  In the original game, we had only a few real variables in determining how an adventure plays- varying the number of cards drawn, the number of resources earned, how many resources Sauron earns, and how many cards he can hold in his hand.  We wanted a more comprehensive set of tools to adjust the game and to create truly different styles of play.  With our upcoming overhaul of the game, players will be able to finally have a more diverse set of options in how the game plays between modes.   

The new tools we have at our disposal now include several new ways to approach the game:

[list]
[*] Stat differences by play style
[*] Board Setups by play style and by location
[*] Sauron Deck composition by play style
[*] Sauron Card Restrictions by play Style
[/list]

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Stat differences by Play Style[/b]
We now have the ability to change stats on cards by play style, meaning we can enhance or reduce an enemy unit's stats by the chosen play style.  

While we have the ability to do this on an absolute basis, we chose to restrict these changes to the type of enemies we call Villains ('boss' enemies) only, and only for each Villain's health. The reason for this limited use is overall balance.  Attack stats are carefully considered by the number of attacks that enemy has per round and how much damage they can inflict using keywords like [i][b]Guard[/b][/i], [i][b]Block[/b][/i] or [i][b]Counter[/b][/i] (and via attachments).  

Small changes in stats can have a major change in how the game plays out, so we have started with baby steps whenever making changes to the game.  In our own playtests, changing Villain health between play modes results in a nice difference in how the boards feel without affecting overall enemy play balance, whereas if we make wholesale changes to all enemies across the board, the result ends up being very chaotic and less fulfilling. 

Once live, we will watch the play data to see how this plays out, but for now we have no plans to make changes other than to Villain health (though we will retain this tool in our playbook for the future).

[b]For Example:[/b]
Here is the Giant Slug in the various play modes...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/fc6370e40b3e14e97a7d06b572397eecc1d72e5d.png[/img]
[i]Narrative Mode[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/794462e648e825144d60142f947cc96485827180.png[/img]
[i]Adventure Mode[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5bd435857a2db6ba53442ccff2d4163fc0c38407.png[/img]
[i]Challenge Mode[/i]

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Board Setups by Play Style by Location[/b]
We now have the ability to change what the initial board setups a player will see at each location in the game based on the chosen play style.  Previously, you would see the same board setup regardless of play style.  This meant that we had to be very selective on the enemies chosen for a location so that it wasn't too difficult for Narrative style players, but yet challenging enough for Challenge style players.  This made for setups that really didn't satisfy either and made Adventure style less distinctive.  

Now we can create unique board setups for each play style that better suits our goals for each.  Adventure play style will retain something akin to the original board setups, while Narrative setups will feature enemies that aren't quite so imposing or punishing.  Challenge players will enjoy new setups that require more strategic thinking before play in order to overcome the situations presented.  

We can also change these setups for single and multiplayer games so that you might see different enemy board setups between how you approach them in single and cooperative play.

[b]Example- [i]Attercop, Attercop[/i][/b]
To illustrate how these setups will vary, here are the initial setups for each of the different play modes for the quest, [i]Attercop, Attercop[/i].

[i]Single Player Narrative Mode[/i]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/cf0691f838e79af4e89d80877c86ac78d7734528.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9b579bde2ec3b4fa21b3bde64fdd0467a6b2fcc9.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the thumbnail to see a larger image.)[/i]

[i]SIngle Player Adventure Mode[/i]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/13f03a08b7e52d765163aeb22db9c5cf19ca1480.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7446c5f940bd2f8b7ff1c78798fcbb0802f461ab.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the thumbnail to see a larger image.)[/i]

Single Player Challenge Mode
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/d39ae5cf143861006ec6def6b2553dd86683e05f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2bf25d54dc99b51a0a25145e6e89b2efb3c5e2b3.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the thumbnail to see a larger image.)[/i]

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Sauron Deck Setups by Play Style [/b]
In addition to having only one board setup for all three play modes, we originally had only the ability to offer one Sauron deck for all three play modes.  Again, this meant that we could really only create one deck for all three play modes, with the same random chance of cards showing up (or not showing up) for all three modes.  

As part of our design changes, we've added the ability to create three distinctly different decks for each play mode.  This means we can favor certain enemies, or certain resource costs, or even more events in one play mode versus less in another.  This allows us to really tailor the experience for the mode of play moving forward.  

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Sauron Card Restrictions by Play Style[/b]
This is a new tool in our toolbox that was revealed when we released Campaign 2 as well as in our initial rebalance of Campaign 1.  We have the ability to restrict what cards Sauron can play on any given location, but the enhancement we've now added is that we can now do this on a per play mode basis.  

Additionally, from a design perspective, our game is asymmetric between how Sauron plays and how you play.  This means that Sauron can play cards and perform actions that you as a player cannot (and vice versa).  In practical terms, this means that, unlike the player, Sauron reshuffles his deck and continues play when he uses up his initial deck.  This usually works well, but can result in certain cards being played more often than we would like.  For this reason, we can restrict certain cards from being reshuffled back into the deck after they have been played.  

[h1][u]——————————————————————————————————[/u][/h1]
[b]Two Modes of Play for Cooperative Multiplayer Mode[/b]
In addition to the above changes for balance, we've also added an additional play style to cooperative multiplayer.  You may now choose between Narrative and Challenge modes in multiplayer to better suit how you wish to play.  We decided to add only one additional play style to cooperative play mode for now so that we can analyze the play data.  We will make a determination down the road if there is a need to add all three modes of play in multiplayer mode.

Unlike MP Challenge mode, all health/quest point stats for Sauron cards will be calculated at 1.7x rather than 2x the original unit stat.  Fate event costs are determined by the designer, but will roughly follow these guidelines.

Let's look at the board setups for [i]Attercop, Attercop[/i] for Cooperative Multiplayer:
[i]Multiplayer Adventure Mode[/i]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/57a99bdaca493c8e8ab44e11a33122e532504752.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/49bd7ea15dd06b7ae6fb69c53ddfeead1d06ec0d.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the thumbnail to see a larger image.)[/i]

[i]Multiplayer Challenge Mode[/i]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/78b4c943d5498727578ddd6fd410fc0dd9b8256a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e29762618feba66f0a383c2bf490f80a317303a4.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click on the thumbnail to see a larger image.)[/i]

You can see that with 5 different possible board setups between the single and multiplayer play styles, there is now the possibility for more diverse game experiences.  In some cases, the changes will be subtle, and at other times, the differences will be very noticeable. Either way, we hope you will enjoy these changes.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch Stream[/h1]

Don't forget that you can check out our Twitch channel at https://www.twitch.tv/ffigames every two weeks at 1pm Central US time / 6:00pm UTC. 

Our next stream will be tomorrow, Wednesday, May 8th.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
That's it for this week. Next week we'll be discussing what additional new elements we have in store for The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game.  Until we meet again, may the stars shine ever on your adventures!

[i][h1][b]Hail and Well Met![/b][/h1][/i]
Over the last weeks, we've discussed the coming major update and the ramifications for how they will change the game moving forward.  These changes include:
[list]
[*] Major UI changes
[*] New cosmetic options to dress up your game or celebrate your favorite characters and moments of play
[*] A whole new way to refine and sort your decks
[*] The much asked for save game feature
[*] An all new tutorial campaign
[*] A new scoring and reward system
[*] Plus more changes large and small.
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/2565272236259813726]Deck Building[/url]

We look forward to you tearing into all the new changes, trying out the new tutorial and earning all the great new rewards.
