notes.title: Weekly Update, February 15th
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5b25b4979705ed9a42001fa9ecc61d4a07392cab.png[/img]

Well met, gentle folk!

This week we've been continuing work on the game internally.  We've been very happy to see the amount of play MP is getting and the discussions both here and on our Discord channel.  

Keep the ideas and feedback coming!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Change in weekly update schedule![/b]

We will be changing our weekly updates to Tuesdays rather than Fridays starting next week on February 19th.  News and Announcements will be made each week then.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]User Experience Enhancement Work Continues[/b]

We're all heads down working on user experience enhancements that have been outlined previously and in our Twitch Stream this week, so there's not a lot news this week. We do have a few things we want to give you a sneak peek at, such as upcoming cards that will be available when Sphere Level 3 cards become available with The Shadow's Fall official release. On this note, we're getting close to being able to announce when it will launch. Be sure to stay tuned to find out more about that in the future!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Multi Level Card Sneak Peek![/b]

With multi-level Sphere cards, you are giving up deck diversity in order to double down on a single sphere's capability.  That means you lose access to some powers that are part of a Sphere's focus by choosing to reduce the number of Spheres you use.  For that reason, as we design multi-level Sphere cards, we operate under a set of rules to compensate for this.

First, if a card grants an effect that is part of a Sphere's focus, it should either be at a lower resource cost or grant a more powerful effect than normal.  

Second, a card can grant an effect that is outside of a Sphere's focus when multi-level, but if it does, it should be at a higher resource cost than what would be normal for that Sphere.

With that in mind, here are some Sphere Level 3 cards we wanted to share with you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Erebor Battlemaster[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/66fe08e6b2ba1db4de5be525a653ac9f070ecc7c.png[/img]

The Erebor Battlemaster is, potentially, a very powerful card.  You may only add him to a deck if you use triple Tactics heroes, and his power is only effective when you have lots of Dwarves on the table—if you do, he can become devastating.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]A Light From Within[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/9a48a2837d89c48cc2e80c61b8b9d9850943835f.png[/img]

A Light From Within is another card with a potentially powerful effect.  For each Ally, you gain 1 Willpower.  You may only use this card if you have 3 Leadership Heroes—but if you do, you will become a Questing machine.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

These cards are undergoing internal testing now and are subject to change before release, but we wanted to give you a sneak peek to discuss.

That's it for this week.  

Fair winds to you all until next time!

FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: Weekly Update, February 8th, 2019- Mithril Upgrade Extended!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7d363bb3ebef3cd2fa481b6827ea69fd3e95f633.jpg[/img]

[b]Well met people of Middle-earth![/b]

We also wish you Earth-bound people a happy new year of the Pig!

With a portion of the dev team off celebrating the Lunar New Year, the rest of the team has been focusing on bug fixes and designing our new Tutorial, UI enhancements and quality of life improvements for rollout in the coming weeks.

Besides all of this behind the scenes development, there's additional news we wanted to share.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Mithril Upgrade Extended![/b]

First, we've decided to extend the Mithril Bundle Upgrade through this weekend! 
 
If you want to buy one of the existing Founder's packages or upgrade your existing Founder's pack to the Mithril Bundle, this weekend is your last chance. to do so and lock in the exclusive Mithril Bundle content.


The Mithril Bundle upgrades your existing Founder's pack to the Mithril level with the following unique Avatars, Player Tag Frames and Card Backs:

[b]Player Avatars[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bdc60b50ad4f5297e85cced2f9c8145d1d08dda1.png[/img]   [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/224641cd2f7490cc56e8eda53a0ffe60443f0cf8.png[/img]

[b]Player Tag Frame[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7dc1c934d0a2c71dd33a2ed83843e1fe564f832c.png[/img]

[b]Card Back[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/dc02799b83cc91371b7f9792632537cf5e729f1b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/889f7e7344246c2420dcf722fc4a6ca9fb599173.png[/img][/url]

In addition, you'll receive all Mithril pack bonuses we've mentioned previously, including alt-art, new exclusive card backs, and the first and second Expansion DLC packs for free!

To upgrade to the Mithril Bundle, visit:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9190/Lord_of_the_Rings_Living_Card_Game_Founders_Bundle/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Core Set Goes Live Next Week[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/dc29a0941c4b8e0628b152f488d3ca87423a940d.png[/img]

With the extension of the Mithril Bundle upgrade deadline, we've decided to hold off switching to the new Core Set until Monday at 10am Central Time (US).  

After this change, the Founder's packs will no longer be available.  Instead, we offer you the the Core Set as a single point of entry into Middle-earth in anticipation for leaving Early Access later in 2019.  (Don't worry, this has no effect on any existing packs or users- this change only applies to new purchases made after the switchover on Monday.)

The Core Set is priced at $18.99 (prices vary by territory- see your local Steam store for exact pricing).  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Scoring Fix[/b]

When we released multiplayer, a scoring glitch made its way into the game which caused players to receive different scores when completing the game.  A fix was deployed on the server side last weekend to all players and has been live this week.  Both players should now receive the same score based on the best possible joint score achieved.

Remember that if you play as a guest on a quest you have not yet unlocked, you receive no score.  Be sure to unlock all of your quests to receive a score!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b]Helpshift[/b]
This is a reminder that assistance for game issues is only a click away.  We've built a HelpShift button directly into the upper left of the Options menu.  Helpshift allows you to contact us directly with bug or issue reports.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/724c69d91f461c0cc98373eb4d2e33a5fa8642a2.jpg[/img]

If you encounter any issues, you can contact us at any time directly from within the game. If you can't get into the game, you can submit a Helpshift report directly at...

https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/asmodee-net/

For more information about filing HelpShift requests, as well as how to include your player log, check out:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/1735463620081440495/

That's it for this week.  Have a great weekend and may your paths be green and golden.

-FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: January 24 Update - Coop mode launch, and more!
notes.notes:
A glorious cooperative day to you all!

For all of those that watched the recent stream on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ffigames]FFIGames Twitch channel[/url], we're sure you're aware that this week's blog will be focused on none other than coop mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/14f8d6ad6e2424476399d2dccf52852f98f99799.jpg[/img]

We were amazingly pleased with the reception that the new mode had during our Twitch stream. If you've not had a chance to check this out, then we highly recommend that you take a few moments to head on over and see it for yourself. You can do so by clicking the link below:

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/369056481][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2855efc618a4c0e5d1f5281540357dfc45f9f6f3.jpg[/img][/url]

If you haven't already learned this crucial and wondrous piece of information from watching the stream, then we're happy to inform you that we now have a date for the launch of the cooperative mode in Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game! Without much further ado and cheer in our hearts we are pleased to finally announce that the date cooperative mode will be launching is January 30!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/e14312e861dd59302921e8a976f2f4c5f59ddf6f.jpg[/img]

[b]We're ready, are you?[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

[b][h1]THE DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP[/h1][/b]

In addition to the previously discussed coop mode, we wanted to give you a quick update regarding the game's development road map. We are currently working on multiple improvements that are intended to assist in both accessibility and make the UI more readable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/be8a04e1786affa01a5e3e76d2bc8398541d133d.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW PLAYER EXPERIENCE[/b]

One of the main complaints we have been seeing regarding new player experience is the difficulty they are exposed to as soon as they begin playing. We are currently working on improving the opening quests to create a narrative experience that better teaches new players, improving their experience. This will not only teach the game flow and how to play, but it will now also include an introduction to deck building.

Our ultimate goal with this revamped tutorial for Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game is to have users fully versed in the game's flow and mechanics before the end of the first campaign. Part of this will also include a small rework to the rewards system, showcasing how the unlocking of valor cards and other content works.

[B]ACCESSIBILITY: BALANCING, UI IMPROVEMENTS AND REWARD SYSTEMS[/B]

As well as the new player experience being a core goal for us to improve before the official launch of Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game, we are also working on specific improvements towards accessibility to aid both new and veteran players alike. 

We will be doing this via three specific routes; Balancing the difficulty curve, reviewing our reward systems and improving the UI. 

The first step for this is the most important to us as it is currently something that scares away many new players, the difficulty curve. We will be adjusting the level of difficulty you encounter in the opening missions to ensure a smooth learning curve, rather than a cliff as steep as those of the Misty Mountains. Another system we are exploring to ease the experience of all players is the introduction of a save system during quests, providing players with more opportunities for exploring their play and being able to guarantee shorter sessions if you are unable to commit to longer play.

The second step will be ensuring an improved reward system that provides the appropriate compensation for those willing to explore creative deck building. This will give players more reasons to attempt quests with more inventive and wild deck styles that will challenge even the most veteran of players! We are also investigating the quality of the Valor Points system, card rewards and the overall systems for player progression. We will provide more information on this at a later date.

Lastly, improving the UI. This will involve a variety of changes that we cannot go into too many details on at this time, but our aim is to make the game more approachable and readable by clearly stating what is happening on the board at all times and how it impacts play. Incorporation of your feedback—while very important in all of our changes—is especially vital for us regarding this topic, so be sure to let us know your thoughts on the forums.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]
[h1]Economic Model Changes[/h1]
As most of you are aware, we have been planning for changes to the economic model of the game. Initiating this was our recent implementation of an upgrade bundle for all current Founder's Pack purchasers that allowed you to upgrade to the Mithril Pack. We wanted to alert you that we are currently finalising the economic model changes and will be deploying the new one-tier payment model to purchase the base game of Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game. 

This model will more closely emulate that of the physical version with there only being a single tier which unlocks all base game content. Additional content will of course become available at later dates, both free of charge and via DLC.

If you're wanting to guarantee your access to all of the Founder's Pack bonuses, we highly recommend that you jump on the opportunity to get your Mithril Bundle soon! Some of the cool exclusives you can get are unique avatars and Player Tag Frames and Card Backs, as seen below:

[b]Player Tag Frames[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7dc1c934d0a2c71dd33a2ed83843e1fe564f832c.png[/img]

[b]Card back[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/dc02799b83cc91371b7f9792632537cf5e729f1b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/889f7e7344246c2420dcf722fc4a6ca9fb599173.png[/img][/url]

You still have time to upgrade to the Mithril Bundle here:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9190/Lord_of_the_Rings_Living_Card_Game_Founders_Bundle/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png[/img]

We're looking forward to getting all these changes into your hands and moving ever closer to the elusive goal of full release. In the meantime we hope you enjoy the all new coop mode, and keep your eyes open for more information about the next campaign release; The Shadow's Fall!

-Asmodee Digital and Fantasy Flight Interactive

notes.title: Weekly Update, January 18th, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/d28a874459d91536d0d363cf2d413f377513e2a0.png[/img]
[b]Happy Friday![/b]

The word for this week is: new Heroes! 

Okay, yeah, that’s two words. Moving on: in the weekly wrap-up for December 14, we shared two of the new Heroes planned for the next expansion (check it out if you haven’t yet). We were jazzed to show off Fredegar Bolger and Dain Ironfoot, but savvy players know that four Heroes are included with each expansion—so, what about the other two?

Well, wonder no longer! Here’s your sneak peek on the Heroes that’ll round things out. (With the standard caveat, as always, that these cards are subject to change before release.)


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/309489f0a68d7ca48692b01a4c1236862d951ecc.png[/img]


Glorfindel is an Elf of great renown, with a card to match. He’s got a respectable 2 Attack and Willpower and solid 9 Health, but check out his ability: Each round, if he takes damage, he boosts the Fate Meter by 1; but if he isn’t damaged, he lowers the Threat Meter by 1. If you’re looking for dynamic ways to manage your Fate and Threat, Glorfindel’s a great option.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/c6d7725e171bb3a2ed0ccaf9791bc6e22d2b5163.png[/img]

 
Much like Glorfindel himself, the cards in his pack are designed with versatility in mind. Elven Blade offers a nice +1 boost to Attack and Health—and, at just 1 Resource, it’s a great Attachment choice when building an Elf-centric deck.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/8459dc310044242e9a4f94022b02412cf9b2402f.png[/img]


Idraen is a Tactics Hero, so it’s not surprising that combat is where she really shines. Her 2 Attack is decent to start, made more impressive by her ability to ready up once per round after defeating an Enemy. Equip her with Ranger Spear—or any other handy weapon Attachment—and Idraen becomes truly fearsome on the battlefield. Also, as a Dúnadan, you can combine her with Aragorn for a potent Ranger-focused deck. And one more thing: she’s our second original Hero to join the game!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/15b6a464c45df69b4700c86ffdfe975a814c63b8.png[/img]


Dúndedain Trap is designed around a new gameplay mechanic: it returns to your hand after its effect expires. Spending just 1 Resource to lock down a non-unique Enemy for two rounds is pretty useful. Being able to do it more than once with the same card is amazing! The trade-off is that Dúnedain Trap is a Sphere level 3 card. It can only be used in a deck with three Lore Heroes—so get ready to build your Arwin, Faramir, and Fredegar Bolger deck!

We’ve got one more sneak peek before we wrap things up: the Woodman Village Location from the upcoming Shadow’s Fall Campaign. What heartless monsters would set fire to such a peaceful place? 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/0e7070361a079743084c9d9ddfd1e584be807161.jpg[/img]


[b]Deck of the Week[/b]
User kjeld built a deck that’s all about playing smarter, not harder. It can be dicey in heavy duty combat situations, but with some strategic gameplay, you can usually knock out the Objective and get on your way before Sauron’s minions unleash a serious beating.

[b]Kjeld’s Smart and Secret Deck[/b]

Heroes: 
[i]•	Arwen
•	Èowyn
•	Tom Took[/i]

Ally (15)
[i]•	2x Erebor Record Keeper
•	2x Galadriel's Handmaiden
•	2x Gandalf
•	1x Imladris Caregiver
•	2x Ithilien Lookout
•	2x Rhovanion Outrider
•	2x Tom Bombadil
•	2x Wandering Took[/i]

Attachment (5)
[i]•	1x Favor of the Lady
•	2x Forest Snare
•	1x Sting
•	1x Unexpected Courage[/i]

Event (10)
[i]•	2x A Watchful Peace
•	1x Beorn’s Hospitality
•	1x Fair and Perilous
•	2x Gilthoniel! A Elbereth!
•	2x Mithrandir’s Advice
•	2x Study the Scrolls[/i]

We’ve got some big news planned for next week, so stay tuned. Till then, have a great weekend and watch out for those Hazards!

[b][i]FFI and Asmodee Digital[/i][/b]

notes.title: Weekly Update, January 11th, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/13e2d7e586b0d5df342af05f9bc1d30b5a76cfe9.jpg[/img][b]Happy Friday and Happy New Year, everyone![/b]

New content is coming with the new Campaign: T[i]he Shadow Falls[/i] and [i]Valor Vault 2[/i] coming soon.  We’ll have an update on that soon, but in the meantime we wanted to give you some sneak peaks at upcoming content, including a look at two Level 3 cards that are only available to fellowships based around a single Sphere of Influence.  While you give up diversity of effects with these types of decks, the Level 3 cards give you powerful new options.

[b]New Valor Cards-[/b]
When the Valor Vault 2 release comes, you’ll have 3 new cards from each of the individual Spheres, plus a single Neutral Sphere card to choose from (we already released 4 new cards prior to the new year, which rounds out the Valor Vault release).  Here’s a sneak peek at four upcoming cards.

Here are the new cards…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/19b87a360df98571791c50cc94e278afa17915a8.png[/img]

[b]Back to the Dark[/b] is a powerful new Level 2 Spirit card that allows you to defeat any exhausted non-unique enemy.  This gives Spirit decks a little more firepower in combat situations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/6665acdb1d5bc0802f17cf50bfaa9dc27a0d4d0e.png[/img]

[b]Ioreth[/b] is a Level 3 Lore ally with a unique healing power for triple Sphere decks.  She can heal a full 3 health points from any character when she uses her Power as an action.  Additionally, she has just as much Willpower as Willpower as Arwen when you need to resolve an objective or gain Fate Points quickly.  However, with just 3 health, you will need to protect her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/3e40696c1076ed41545818586eb5818b9af12d4c.png[/img]

The powerful Level 3 card Strength of Arms typifies the nature of the Leadership Sphere.  You may ready each of your exhausted characters across the board.  Use this card for those times where extra effort might win the day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/7169a24d2a9d49fe800795ba24c7f80580a61c6f.png[/img]

The stout Dwarf warrior [b]Veteran of Nanduhirion[/b] is a powerful new Tactics ally for your fellowship.  He’s a stout warrior who showcases the new Counter keyword, doing one damage to any attacker.  His resource cost is only 1, but as a result, he arrives on the battlefield with 2 damage already on his character, so you will need to heal him if you want to make the most of this character.

Finally, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at the upcoming Shadow’s Fall campaign by showing you the Dol Guldur Library location.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/b751d8bbdcb5fa25dea5defd13bc336b35cb6e6a.png[/img]

Who knows what dark sorceries were imagined by The Necromancer in this strange place filled with terrible knowledge?  

[b]Deck of the Week[/b]

This week we’re featuring a deck by [b]ransomman[/b] in direct response to “We Must Away,” the Fourth Quest in the Shadow’s Reach campaign.  Though we are looking at the balance of this level longer term, this deck should help you overcome this challenging quest.

Éowyn
Tom Took[/i]

[/list][/i]

[/list][/i]

Event (14)

That’s it for this week, but watch this space for news and updates.

Have a great weekend!

FFI and Asmodee Digital

notes.title: New Year's Update and News
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/202599b28beca4180055ad25530c8573a4d1a130.png[/img]
[b]Happy New Year, The Lord of the Rings fans![/b]
 
Our staff had a nice break during the holidays, spending time with friends and family, and now we’re all back into the swing of things.  There’ve been a few changes that coincided with the holidays, so we have a lot of news to share on our plans for supporting the game both in the near and long term.
 
There’s lots to cover, so I apologize in advance for the length of this news post.
 
[b]Social Media Changes[/b]
First off, you’ll note that this post is coming from me, your friendly neighborhood studio head, rather than from Luke, our community manager.
 
We’ve been a bit quiet on this front the past few weeks.  Part of that is the holidays, but part of that is the fact that Luke decided to depart FFI and try his hand at doing personal work in social media and writing.  We wish him the best and will be watching with interest to see what he does.  We’ll always be fans of Luke and he’ll always be welcome here as a friend of the studio and someone who was pivotal in making this game come to life.  
 
We’re working with our partners at Asmodee Digital to get our various channels up and going again soon.  Look for more input here and on our other channels directly from the folks at Asmodee Digital, while we at FFI continue to reach out ourselves to toss around ideas, provide feedback and keep you informed.
 
[b]Twitch Streams[/b]
We will continue Twitch streams, but likely at a different pace than previously until we have our long-term plan sorted out.  This means no regular Tuesday and Thursday streams for now, but we do want to begin again as soon as possible.  We see these streams as an important way to reach out to you, so keep an eye out for when the next one will be.
 
[b]Content Releases[/b] [i](Important Release News!)[/i]
 
[b][i]Campaign 2: The Shadow’s Fall[/i][/b]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/0f143c99ecc7e0e5841a2dc95c4e992ee99b85c8.png[/img]
 
We originally announced here that this would release on January 9th, but we’ve made the call to postpone this release until a later week. As we were completing the content for this new campaign, we needed to upgrade our code base to the latest version of Unity, and this had a bigger impact than we first expected.  Combined with the holidays, this means that we need additional time to polish the release before it goes live.  No excuses -- if you want to blame someone for this release going late, blame me for making this call.  We should have a new release date to announce shortly and we will be giving you a sneak peek at the new campaign soon in our renewed Twitch streams.
 
[b][i]Valor Vault 2 Release[/i][/b]
 
We’ve also decided to hold the Valor Vault release until Campaign 2 launches.   When Campaign 2 is released, you’ll also get access to the remaining new Valor Vault cards on the same day.
 
[b]Cooperative Multiplayer Status[/b]
We’ve been testing multiplayer quite a bit internally and the final UI tweaks are being put in place.  We’ll do some last internal play and stress testing, then release it into the wild.  The team and I want to get MP into your hands as soon as we can so we can get your feedback and input changes based upon them.  This interactive feedback is the major point of an Early Access game. Your feedback has been invaluable thus far, and we look forward to continuing that back-and-forth with you now with cooperative play.
 
You’ll see a change soon to the main menu that will look like this:
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/09aa0d28347ddd149ba0d4af75430fc34b58774e.jpg[/img]
 
When Cooperative Multiplayer goes live, you’ll be able to click on the Multiplayer window and start a new game.  From there, you can host or join a session, invite friends either from your Steam or Asmodee.net friends list, or just hit the fast play button to jump into a random game.
 
We’ll save more details on specific elements of functionality and details of how MP works for a later post and upcoming stream.
 
[b]Short Term Focus[/b]
Once Campaign 2 and Cooperative MP are live and in your hands, we’re turning our focus back to the First Time User Experience ([i]FTUE[/i]), Player Onboarding and general game balance.
 
[b]FTUE and Player Onboarding[/b]
The First Time User Experience sets your expectations for the entire game.  We could be doing better here.  We want you to be welcomed into the game, shown the key elements and then be able to dive into adventure.  To get there, we’ll be changing the current experience quite a bit for our full release.
 
The first change is the tutorial.  We want initial players to get the basics quickly and then choose either to dive right into play or, if you wish, take the time to learn more of the subtle aspects of our game. 
 
We make no bones about our game having a lot of complex interactions.  The LOTR LCG allows you to just throw around your cards, but the game will punish you if you do.  To get the most out of gameplay, you to really consider your options with each play you make. 
 
Our data analysis shows that there are predominantly two camps of players: those who love the lore and simply want to experience the narrative, and those who enjoy an intense challenge.  We think there’s a better way for us to serve both audiences better; changing how we bring you into the game is just the first step.
 
While some very vocal players can’t get enough challenge, other players come in and get smacked around pretty hard by our first quest and campaign.  Some players are totally up for that, but a large part of the audience just isn’t.  For that reason, we’re looking to further refine how the Narrative setting works within the game so that we can better deliver an experience that audience is looking for.
 
However, this doesn’t mean we won’t come up with more challenges for the other camp of players.  We’ll continue to create more devious ways to challenge our toughest players, which you’ll always be able to find in the Challenge setting.
 
[b]Balance and Scoring[/b]
As part of this effort, we’ll also change how scoring works.  Coming up with a single score system that promotes all types of play is a real challenge.  We’ve got with some ideas that we will unveil as part of our FTUE relaunch.  Our plans are to make scoring more transparent, better promote replay ability and grant rewards quickly. 
 
[b]Deckbuilding and Card Earning[/b]
The Valor Vault will change somewhat, too, mostly in how you earn cards.  Much more on that in the coming weeks, but in general we plan to cast off some vestiges of the old economic model.
 
[b]Quality of Life and Other Changes[/b]
We’re always looking at improving the UI experience and what we call “quality of life” issues in the game.  This means adding subtle changes and new simple additions or consolidations to make the game flow faster and make the game feel snappier, the UI more logical and generally just “feel right.”   
 
[b]Artificial Intelligence[/b]
We’re also always tweaking AI.  As a game that focuses mostly single and cooperative play (PvE), AI is an ongoing challenge.  We continue to make changes so that Sauron avoids dumb plays and give him better tools to play the game and make him feel more like an opponent than a scripted enemy.  Some of these changes are coming in the new content releases, and others will come with the new Cooperative Multiplayer mode.

[b]Core Set[/b]
Soon new users to the game will have only the Core Set as a purchase option in the store.  We'll be retiring the Founder's Packs at that time.  This won't change your current purchase status or reward plan, but it will make the purchase options for the game less confusing to newcomers.    

This update is already getting long, so we’ll just end it here for now.  Look to the Steam discussion pages as well as our other channels for news, throw us suggestions, or simply talk about the game. 

As always, we appreciate you playing The Lord of the Rings Living Card Game and being a part of our community.  We have a fantastic base of fans and we’re striving hard to keep new content coming and grow our audience.

We have a lot to show you in 2019 and we can't wait to do so.

Until next time!

FFI_Tim
Fantasy Flight Interactive Studio Head

notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: December 21, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f45a2c9d26f6782c605f0338f0750099fd5fe55e.png[/img]

Happy Friday, everyone! 

A  little end-of-the-year gift is coming to the Valor Vault next week. Four new cards will be added as a thank-you to players for joining us in our first year. 

Additionally, we have news regarding co-op and more—let’s get to it! 

[h1]New Valor Cards[/h1]
Four bonus cards are coming to the Valor Vault as a special year end thank-you: 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2a66cdd6aaaae5b8c2f7bb69621ec683da8c8f28.png[/img]
Guardian of Arnor shows off the upcoming Counter keyword, which deals 1 damage to an Attacker when attacked. Note that this stacks on top of reciprocal damage from Guard, so the Guardian will deal a total of 3 damage to Attackers when Defending! 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/93eafe551d2619c985765bc3c57ab1671b9a2d96.png[/img]
With Ride to Ruin, a Rohan Ally can make a noble sacrifice, adding progress to an Objective at the cost of the ultimate price. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5c9ba8be2abef984e3550bd30b80798deb11a100.png[/img]
Fornost Bowman is a powerful Tactics Ally who gets stronger as he defeats foes.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5fb87704021165feddbb80448cc695d6370acb69.png[/img]
And finally, The Road Goes Ever On is the first card to reference Fate in its text. We can’t wait to see what decks you build with it! 


As always, you’ll be able to spend the Valor Points you’ve earned by playing the game on these new Valor Cards. They will be available on Thursday, December 27, so make sure to check them out in the Valor Vault at that time! 

These cards are a preview of the next Valor Vault release, coming to The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game soon. How soon, you ask? 

[h1]New Valor Vault Release Coming January 9[/h1]
In just a few short weeks, the next round of Valor Cards will be added to the Valor Vault. You’ll be able to unlock these new cards using Valor Points. 13 cards will join the cards released on Thursday, totaling the number of Valor cards in this wave at 17 (4 cards from each sphere, plus 1 Neutral.) 

But that’s not the only thing coming to the game on January 9. 

[h1]The Shadow's Fall Is Coming January 9! [/h1]
That’s right: We’re hitting the ground running in January, and the Expansion The Shadow’s Fall will be released along with the new Valor Vault cards. 

This isn’t typically how we’ll release content—usually, Valor Vault releases will come separate from new Expansions. However, we wanted to start 2019 with a big content drop, including a new Campaign, 4 new Hero Packs, new Valor cards, new mechanics, and more. The Shadow’s Fall expands on existing mechanics and keywords and brings with it the Counter and Ambush keywords. 

Finally, the Shadow’s Fall brings a third Hero from each Sphere to The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game, and as a result, we’re introducing one of the most anticipated card types to the game: Level 3 Cards! 

We previewed some of these cards on Thursday’s stream. You can get a first look at twitch.tv/ffigames. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/87a8eb811d53325e61c3c84891f70cf23b4243b1.png[/img]

Check back the week of January 9 for a closer look at the incoming mechanics and cards! 


[h1]Co-Op Update [/h1]
On Tuesday’s stream, we went over some of the changes we’re making to cooperative play, based on initial player feedback and internal testing. 

First off,[b] co-op will now have a Shared Fate Meter[/b]. The Cost of Fate Events will increase to compensate for this, and Fate Events will only be able to be used once. 

Secondly, [b]players will be able to play Attachments on other players’ Characters. [/b]You’ll be able to grant a blade to your partner’s Heroes, and we hope this will encourage more cooperation! 

Finally, [b]we’re working on balance to make sure the gameplay in co-op feels challenging and consistent. [/b]We’ll be adjusting things like Sauron’s Resources, Enemy stats, and more in order to achieve the right balance. 

All that being said: We’ve decided that co-op, while stable, just isn’t quite ready for its Early Access debut this month.[b] We’re pushing co-op to January, though we don’t have a firm date.[/b] It will come later that month, after the release of The Shadow’s Fall and the new Valor Vault cards. We hope that having more cards in the pool at co-op’s release will lead to greater deck diversity among players! 

[h1]New Year Schedule [/h1]
There will not be any streams or Weekly-Wrap Ups for the next two weeks as we prepare for the New Year. We’ll see you on January 11 with the next Wrap-Up, though we’ll have more news to share on the 9th for the release of Expansion 2, The Shadow’s Fall! 

[h1]Deck of the Week [/h1]

[b]The Angry Elf by Iluvatar 79 [/b]
How much damage can a Character deal in a single attack? That’s the question Iluvatar 79 asked with this Double Spirit deck. The answer is apparently 51! This is a combo deck in every sense of the word, built to stretch the limits of the game for fun—and profit. Check it out below, and click on this link for a full description from the deckbuilder: https://digital.ringsdb.com/decklist/view/52/the-angry-elf-1.0

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/d28a874459d91536d0d363cf2d413f377513e2a0.png[/img]

Happy Friday! 

This week’s headline: We showed co-op for the first time on Thursday’s stream, and we’ve already received a lot of great feedback. Head to that stream’s archive to take a look for yourself (twitch.tv/ffigames), or check out the summary below. 

Let’s get to it! 

[h1]Co-Op [/h1]

The co-op stream on Thursday revealed a few details about the upcoming mode. 

[b]First, we’re aiming for a release by the end of the month.[/b] We’re going to use co-op’s initial release period to tune and refine cooperative gameplay, putting out balance patches and releasing new features. Here’s a quick run-down of some details about how co-op plays:

[b]Turn order goes as follows: Player one takes an action, Sauron takes an action, then player two takes an action.[/b] Like in single-player, turns in a round pass back and forth until all players have passed. If one player passes, the action will move back and forth between the other player and Sauron. If Sauron passes, action will pass between the two players. 

[b]Co-op uses a voting system to decide who receives Quest-specific cards like Sting or Mysterious Whistle.[/b] If players don’t agree on who should receive the card, the game will randomly grant it to one player.  

[b]Sauron’s units have double their starting health in co-op play. [/b]This makes them a little more difficult to fight through. We’re not done balancing how units scale up for co-op play. 

[b]Sauron gets 6 resources in co-op mode. [/b]

[b]Players can take the same Heroes in their Fellowship, but Allies are unique. [/b]Sorry folks—no double Erkenbrands allowed. However, if each player each wants to take Aragorn into battle, for example, they can do so. 

[b]We’re adjusting how the Fate Meter will work in co-op. [/b]Check back next week for more details on that. 

[b]Starting Threat is averaged between both players’ Heroes.[/b] Furthermore, the Threat meter is shared, so players will experience Threat events at the same time. We’re going to continue balancing Threat in co-op as well, as Threat reduction is quite powerful in the current state. 

We’ll continue to look at co-op on future streams—stay tuned for more details! 

[h1]Card Spoilers[/h1]
On Tuesday’s stream, we took a look at some in-development cards coming in the next round of Hero Packs. You can watch that stream’s archive for details, but the cards are as follows. Please note that these cards are subject to change before release!

We’ll have more card spoilers for you next week! 

[h1]Deck of the Week [/h1]
User Seastan snags a back-to-back with this King Of Carrion build (this time with 100% more Arwen). We just couldn’t help but feature this deck after we used it to handily clear King of Carrion on Challenge mode Tuesday! notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: December 7, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/5e5db79653c4c812c37dd90b547e2052f8a7997f.png[/img]

Happy Friday everyone! We’re back with another Weekly Wrap-Up, post-PAX Unplugged. If you visited us at the show, thanks again! It was great meeting fans and new players alike. 

With the new year fast approaching, we wanted to update you on the current status of things in this week’s Wrap-Up. Let’s jump in.

[h1]Bugs and Fixes[/h1]

It’s been brought to our attention that there are some errors in certain non-English versions of cards (words incorrectly bolded, etc.). If you notice an error like this, please let us know on Twitter, Facebook, or through HelpShift. Thanks in advance!

Some users have reported that cards are “hanging,” especially during King of Carrion. This bug is a high priority for us, as it can sometimes bring gameplay to a halt. 

We are also investigating some reported performance issues on King of Carrion, as well as some occasional crashes separate from the hanging cards issues. 

If you experience any of these issues, please let us know by submitting a HelpShift. Here’s the guide to submitting a ticket:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/1735463620081440495/

[h1]A Quick Word on Co-Op[/h1]

Internal testing and implementation on co-op mode is underway now, and we’re targeting a beta release before the end of the month. During Early Access, we’ll work to refine co-op from its initial state, adding features and tuning the experience before full release.

 Before co-op goes live, however, we’ll show it on a developer stream on our Twitch page at twitch.tv/ffigames. Stay tuned there for more news, especially in the upcoming week! 

[h1]The King of Carrion[/h1]

Now that King of Carrion is available for all players, we’ve received a ton of feedback on it—feedback that we plan to use to refine the Encounter itself, as well as shape future Encounters. Here’s what that means in the short-term and long-term. 

First, we plan to further tune the difficulty of King of Carrion. Our mission with Encounters is to make challenging one-off Quests that provide new experiences for veteran players. We’re going to take another look at King of Carrion and tune its difficulty up on Challenge mode while maintaining a good experience for players on Narrative and Adventure. 

Second, we’re aware of issues with the audio mixing on certain Locations and Story Screens in King of Carrion. We plan to issue a fix for this soon—most likely early next week. We’ll keep you updated. 

One area we haven’t received much feedback about is the reward card for King of Carrion. How do you feel about earning a card for an Encounter? What do you think of Northern Survivor?  Let us know here or on the Steam Community Forums. We’d love to hear your feedback on the card rewards! 

Finally, we heard your feedback on the story, narration, and presentation of King of Carrion, and it was largely positive. We’ll keep this in mind for future Campaigns and Encounters and strive to bring you to interesting and cool corners of Middle-earth. 

Thank you to everyone who played King of Carrion! If you haven’t played it yet, or if you’re looking for a cool new build to try and take on the adventure—check out the Deck of the Week! 

 [h1]Deck of the Week[/h1]

[b] Seastan’s King of Carrion—Challenge Mode Perfect Score (No Arwen)[/b]

When taking on The King of Carrion, many considered Arwen to be an auto-include in their list. User Seastan took that as a challenge and built a list without the Hero that many considered a staple on the Encounter. 

Faramir acts as both a powerhouse and draw engine, while Aragorn brings tough Leadership allies and a Power that allows him to cheat on actions. Finally, Èowyn powers through Objectives and cleans up Hazards while holding her own in combat. Check it out:

Have a great week, everyone.

notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: November 16, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/13e2d7e586b0d5df342af05f9bc1d30b5a76cfe9.jpg[/img]

It’s Friday, all, and that means it’s time for another Weekly Wrap-Up! This week, we’ll be focusing on the big update going live this Wednesday. It’ll bring with it some new content, some quality-of-life upgrades, and a couple of difficulty adjustments we want to try out. Let’s jump in. 

[h1]Bugs and Fixes[/h1]

[b]Connection Bug[/b]
A very small number of users are having problems connecting their Asmodee accounts. We’ve narrowed down the cause of this problem—now we’re figuring out a fix. If you’re one of the affected, please let us know on Helpshift. 

[b]Investigating Bugged Cards[/b]
We’re working on a fix for The Tree People and Longbeard Mapmaker, both of which are not functioning properly. We’ll let you know when a fix goes live for these cards. 

[h1]The King of Carrion has returned [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2e0dc42c0362588cc420f1310510c40e826f80b7.png[/img]

The first ever Encounter is coming to The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game! 

Titled The King of Carrion, players will guide their Heroes through this standalone Quest that will take them to the far reaches of the Andúin and beyond, battling new enemies such as Moonlight Wights as well as returning foes such as the fearsome wargs. 

All Encounters will be free for all players, regardless of their Founder’s Pack! 

Look for The King of Carrion’s icon to join the map on the Play screen on November 21. 

[h1]The Valor Vault is Opening! [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1d5739ad7a0448abfbe71bfd5ee4c7f554794c09.png[/img]

New Valor cards are coming to the game on November 21! 

13 new cards will join the 4 cards we gave away in September to make up the first wave of Valor Vault releases. With a suite of new Attachments, Allies, and Events, this Valor Vault release has something for everyone. 

Take a look at our announcement here for more details on both the Encounter and the Valor Vault release: https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/2793816605794922123

[h1]
Quality-of-Life Updates to Play Menu[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/caaf4667a4c24418c82093d933946d84d5a93224.png[/img]

A couple of highly-requested features are going live with the incoming update. 

In the Play Menu, you’ll be able to check what rewards each Hero has earned by clicking the brand-new Rewards tab. Right now it tracks the Valor bonus awarded for getting a top score with a Hero, but future bonuses will be tracked here, too! 

Additionally, we’ve introduced a new scrolling system for quickly swapping between decks in the Play menu. Of course, clicking on your Heroes still brings up the old menu—but you can choose to page through them this way, too! 

[b]Quality-of-Life Updates to Deckbuilder[/b]
Three updates are coming to the deckbuilder menu, as well. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/640a92f8de08174dc1cbcd32d622df57a1743170.png[/img]

Firstly, you’ll be able to build a deck over 30 cards and shave down to the deck limit. Note that you’ll still need 30 cards in a deck to make it valid, but this change means you’ll be able to build a deck by cutting cards rather than just by adding them. 

Secondly, you’ll be able to swap Heroes of the same sphere in a deck without removing all the cards of that sphere from the deck. This should make deckbuilding a little quicker! 

Lastly, we're updating the frames for Level 2 cards to make them more recognizable. You can see that change in the image above.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/93e1f6ca4bd45de0c01704263de21d0b9598115a.png[/img] 

[b]Fate Meter UI Update[/b]
Finally, we’re adding a functionality to the Fate meter that will allow you to click and drag your cameos to the Fate meter to contribute their Willpower, rather than having to use the buttons. Both functionalities will still work, but for users on touch-screen displays especially this change should make gameplay go faster. 

These updates wouldn’t have been possible without player feedback, so we’d like to say thanks to everyone who made these suggestions. 

[h1]Adjustments to Difficulty Levels[/h1]

We have two updates going live in the game related to difficulty; one is cosmetic, and the other is mechanic. 

[b]Change in Difficulty Names[/b]
As we continue to make adjustments, we want the Difficulty levels to better reflect the experiences they provide. As a result: 

[b][u]Easy[/u][/b] is becoming [b][u]Narrative[/u][/b]. 
[u][b]Normal[/b][/u] is becoming [u][b]Adventure[/b][/u]. 
[u][b]Hard[/b][/u] is becoming [b][u]Challenge[/u][/b]. 

This is a minor change, but it reflects how we’re approaching each difficulty, moving forward. Speaking of which…

[b]Change to Sauron’s Resources[/b]
We’re experimenting with the amount of Resources Sauron will have at his disposal at each difficulty. Starting Wednesday, we’re making the following adjustments: 

On [u][b]Narrative[/b][/u], he’ll get [u][b]2[/b][/u]. 
On [u][b]Adventure[/b][/u], he’ll get [b][u]4[/u][/b]. 
On [u][b]Challenge[/b][/u], he’ll get [b][u]5.[/u][/b] 

Previously, Sauron got 3 resources regardless of difficulty. This change allows us more room to experiment with his decks’ cost curves and more. 

We’ll be looking for your feedback on this change at each of the difficulty levels. Too much? Not enough? Let us know on the Steam Community forums after you’ve tried it out. Moving forward, we’ll continue to make adjustments to balance each difficulty to the right level. 

[b]No Streams Next Week[/b]
Due to American Thanksgiving, we won’t have any developer streams next week, making it a great time to catch up on old VODs at Twitch.tv/ffigames! 

[h1]Deck of the Week [/h1]

For this Deck of the Week, we’re going to try something new. User Wandalf the Gizzard posted this list on the Steam Community Forums, built only from Starter Cards, looking for suggestions or advice on building: 

Heroes: Tom Took, Arwen, and Aragorn

2x Gaining Strength
2x Guard of the Citadel
2x Warden of Annuminas
2x Erebor Guard
2x Gandalf
2x Watchful Peace
2x Favor of the Lady
2x Secret Paths
2x Wandering Took
2x Rhovanion Outrider
2x Woodland Courier
2x Imladris Caregiver
2x Ithilien Lookout
2x Mithrandir's Advice
2x Advanced Warning

This is a solid list to start, but with the incoming Valor Vault cards, we can make it even better! Next wrap-up, we’ll revisit this list using the brand-new cards and see what changes we can make. In the meantime, if you have ideas, head over to the Steam Community forums and let us know! https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/1/1738848358535618580/

Have a great weekend, everyone. 

FFI

notes.title: New Cards and Encounter Coming Wednesday, November 21
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/f45a2c9d26f6782c605f0338f0750099fd5fe55e.png[/img]

New cards and a new Quest are coming to The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game next week! 

[h1]The King of Carrion has returned to Middle-earth![/h1]

The King of Carrion, the first-ever Encounter, comes to the game free for all users, regardless of their Founder's Pack. 

[b][i]Encounters[/i][/b] are an all-new, ultra-hard game mode tailor-made for veteran players. Unlike Campaigns, Encounters are comprised of a single perilous Quest, and they tell stories that stretch past the darkest corners of Middle-earth. In short, they are difficult standalone challenges exploring The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game’s mechanics, and best of all—they’re free for all players. 

You can read the full description of The King of Carrion below! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/2e0dc42c0362588cc420f1310510c40e826f80b7.png[/img]

[i]It is the coldest winter in the living memory of the Beornings. Refugees are arriving from northeastern farmsteads and hamlets every day. Beorn’s estate and other woodman villages of the Beornings do their best to take in the displaced.

The near-frozen arrivals utter dark tales of happenings in the shadows of the mountains. They talk of the black frost, of moonlings, and the tide of fangs. It is as if Beorning fireside tales of old have come alive. There are even those who say these are but presages to the return of Mordraur, the king of carrion.

Something unnatural is stirring in the mountains.
[/i]

If you complete The King of Carrion successfully, you’ll be awarded with two copies of an all-new Uncommon card added to your collection, the Beorning Ally, Northern Survivor. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/4bc27b7a42d55567dc395279bb5c621565ec8652.png[/img]

Build your deck and prepare for the return of Mordraur on November 21, when The King of Carrion comes to The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game! 

[h1]
The New Wave of Valor Cards is Coming! [/h1]

The Valor Vault is open! 

13 all-new cards are coming to the Valor Vault in The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game, joining the 4 early preview cards we gave out to players back in September. Players can use their Valor to unlock these cards and add them to their collection for deckbuilding. 

This is the first of the scheduled Valor Vault releases and sets the pace for future expansions. Each cycle, we’ll release a new set of cards to the Valor Vault that will give players new options for deckbuilding, expanding the card pool and giving players new ways to experience their Adventures in Middle-earth. Returning and new players alike can access these cards!  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/1d5739ad7a0448abfbe71bfd5ee4c7f554794c09.png[/img]

This Valor Vault introduces several powerful Attachments that change the way Allies and Heroes from the Core Set are played. The Neutral Attachment Narya removes the fleeting keyword from Gandalf and keeps the old wizard in play, while Raven-Winged Helm makes Leadership a formidable force in combat. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/ba6c4274936f81fa3a4d871b151ef7f6dd93f68b.png[/img]

Like all Valor cards, you can unlock these new cards by spending Valor points. They’ll be available for all players.  

These updates will go live in the game after our scheduled downtime on Wednesday, November 21. That's the downtime between Tuesday night and Wednesday morning, to be clear!

 
Happy Questing,
FFI

notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: November 9, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/960c8c1bb2cc8e54573e7feff9f0de1efbc95fa4.png[/img]

Happy Friday, everyone! This week, we took a look at some incoming new cards as well as some quality-of-life changes coming to the deckbuilder and more! Let’s dive into the wrap-up. 
[b]
New Cards Incoming![/b]
This month, we’ll have new cards added to the Valor Vault. On Tuesday’s stream, we previewed a few of those incoming cards, including the powerful Armor Raven-Winged Helm and the Special Attachment Narya. 
[i]Note: These cards are subject to change before release. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/c8c348290068b7d79681bf3891aa1fb812072418.png[/img]
Narya is a powerful Neutral Attachment unlike any other card in The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game. It removes the Fleeting keyword from Istari characters like Gandalf, keeping them in play beyond a single round! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/3f4531a89d4218c337ad24a3d0f93c9a0ecfed2e.png[/img]
Raven-Winged Helm, on the other hand, provides Leadership with a powerful and flexible Attachment in the Armor slot. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/34601ca87e19c4d62a5ef4ae640b5ca96139860e.png[/img]
We also showed an incoming Ally: The returning Forest Protector, who players will remember from the Tutorial. 
[b]
[u]Look for these cards—and more—to be added to the Valor Vault later this month! [/u][/b]
[b]
The King of Carrion[/b] 
The first Encounter, King of Carrion, will be releasing later this month as well, after the Valor Vault expansion. It will be an all-new, standalone Quest available for all players to try. Exploring the far Northern reaches of Rhovanion, you’ll lead your party in a quest to uncover  an ancient unnatural stirring in the mountains. 

Look for The King of Carrion in The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game this month! Players who successfully complete this Encounter will recieve an all-new card as a reward. Check out Tuesday's stream at twitch.tv/ffigames for a first-look at this reward. 
[b]
Fantasy Flight Interactive at Upcoming Conventions[/b]
Fantasy Flight Interactive is a proud sponsor of Gamehole Con here in Madison, WI. We’ll be hanging out in the Fantasy Flight lounge at the show all weekend, showing The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game. If you’re there, come check us out! 

We’ll also be at PAX Unplugged this month, showing demoes. Come find us at the Fantasy Flight Games booth and say hi! 
[b]
Deckbuilder Changes [/b]
We heard your feedback on the deckbuilder, and we’re making changes for future updates. On stream, we previewed some of those updates: 

[b]First, you’ll be able to add more than 30 cards to your deck while deckbuilding and cut down from there.[/b] Decks are still required to be exactly 30 cards, but if you’re the sort of player that likes to build decks by cutting cards, you’ll be able to do so in a future update. This was a feature requested by the community, so we appreciate your feedback in helping us make the game great. 

[b]Second, you’ll be able to swap Heroes of the same Sphere without removing cards of that Sphere from your deck. [/b]So, if you have a deck featuring Aragorn as the Leadership Hero and you’d like to swap him for Dwalin, you’ll be able to do so without removing every Leadership card from your deck. Again, this was a suggestion from the community—so thanks! 

[b][u]Expect these changes to come in an update in the near future.[/u][/b]

[b]
Deck of the Week [/b]
Any card game player worth their salt loves a good two-for-one, and user Sudsywolf is certainly no expception, thanks to achieving a back-to-back feature for the Deck of the Week! This list is a low-curve, high card-draw build that exploits Erebor Record Keeper and a suite of attachments to build a powerful snowball effect for your Heroes. Sudsywolf also points out that this list could potentially serve as a good foundation for a Dwarf deck.

2x Zigil Miner (Valor Cards)

Attachment (8)
2x Dwarven Axe (Core Set)
2x Raiment of War (Valor Cards)
2x Self-Preservation (Core Set)
2x Warrior Sword (Core Set)

Event (7)

2x Lembas (Valor Cards)
 

Have a great weekend, everyone. 
FFI

notes.title: PSA: Valor Reimbursements for Founder's Packs Fixed

Due to a miscommunication, we had not yet distributed all the Valor reimbursements for Founder's Packs. 

 During the downtime last night, we corrected this issue for those affected. This means you received your original Valor as a lump sum on top of your current Valor amount. To recap what that means:

The Steward of Gondor Pack users received 16,000. 

The Istari Pack users received 30,000. 

Mithril Bundle Pack users received 60,000. (We threw in 12,000 extra on top of the Mithril's original 48,000).

Please relaunch the game and make sure that you've received the correct Valor amount. Some users have reported that restarting the game has pushed the update and granted them their missing Valor. If you're unsure after that, let us know on Helpshift: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/asmodee-net/

Want a full breakdown of the reimbursements? Head over to this stickied thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/2791563692135153256/

notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: October 26, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/13e2d7e586b0d5df342af05f9bc1d30b5a76cfe9.jpg[/img]

This weekend is the 2-month anniversary of The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game’s Early Access Release! We wanted to take this moment to thank all the players that have joined us since launch. The past 2 months have flown by, but we’ve made big changes in that time in order to make The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game the best it can be. But we’re not done yet. This week was busy, and November is shaping up to be a big month for us, as well. So let’s jump right in! 

[h1]Tuesday’s Changes[/h1]
To get ready for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/3644993759261680448]upcoming economy change,[/url] we made some adjustments on Tuesday. 

[b]Hero Packs[/b]
On Tuesday’s update, we opened the Hero Packs up to everyone, free of charge. They were automatically added to all players’ collection, regardless of Founder’s Pack level or previous unlocks. 

If you had already unlocked one or more Hero Packs, you received 4000 VP for each pack unlocked. Additionally, if you unlocked extra copies of the cards in the Hero Packs, you received Valor equal to those cards’ Valor cost. 

These reimbursements came in waves, so if some seems to be missing, try relaunching the game; they should appear in your collection. If not, please file a Helpshift and let us know so we can help you out: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/asmodee-net/

Please include your PlayerID in your request.

[b]The Palantìr[/b]
The Palantìr has been removed for the game. You can read more about this decision [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/3644993759261680448]here.[/url] 

If you didn’t have the chance to spend your Palantìr Views, we’re going to convert unspent Palantìr Views to 500 VP each starting next week. Thank you in advance for your patience during this transition. 

[b]Founder’s Pack Updates[/b]
So, how will these changes affect the existing Founder’s Packs? You can read the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/1680298966363774538]here,[/url] but here’s a quick summary: 

[i]Each pack is getting a new exclusive card back.[/i] 
Follow the link above for a sneak peek at these new card backs. 

[i]Everyone received their original Valor amount as an additional gift.[/i] 
This didn’t affect existing Valor unlocks or amounts; it was just added on top of players’ current collection.

[i]The Steward Pack and the Istari Pack are getting exclusive alt-arts of Hero Cards![/i] 
The Steward Pack is getting alt-art versions of Tom Took and Aragorn, and the Istari Pack is getting alts of Arwen and Gimli. This was a highly requested cosmetic item. If they’re popular, we’ll add more in the future, too. 

[i]The Istari Pack also gets the first upcoming expansion, The Shadow’s Fall, for no additional charge.[/i] 
Expansions include new Quests, new Hero Packs, and more. 

[i]The Mithril Bundle gets all the above contents and some additional gifts.[/i]
Those gifts include 4 additional alt-art Heroes (one for each of the current Hero Packs) and Expansion 2, The Witch King’s Grasp, for no charge. 

[b]Scoring Update[/b]
This week, we implemented a wave of changes to scoring to make the system more robust, generous, and easier to understand. After you’ve completed a Quest, you’ll see a summary of your performance along with your score. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1546692751


During Early Access, we’ll keep tuning scoring, so we’ll need your feedback!

[b]Guard Update[/b]
A minor mechanical update: Cards that Exhaust characters (i.e. Sudden Riposte, Thick Webs, etc.) now remove Guard, as well. We did this to give Spirit and Lore new ways to deal with Guard enemies and to give Sauron some options against Guard Allies. Mablung just got a serious power boost! 

[b]The Vault[/b]
The Vault is a new menu taking the place of the Palantìr. In it, you’ll find Hero Packs and Valor cards. Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/509580/discussions/0/1733216893873932193/]this thread for a quick tour of the new menus.[/url]

If you have greyed-out Hero Pack cards in your collection, head over to the Vault and open your packs. Once you do, those cards will be added to your deck builder—no unlock required. You just have to open your packs to get the cards! 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1547060121

In the Valor Vault you can find all the Valor cards available for unlock. Once you have both copies of a Valor card, it’ll no longer appear in the Vault. You can find all your unlocked cards in the Decks menu. Let us know what you think of these changes! 

[b]Talking Co-Op[/b]
On Thursday’s stream, we hosted a brief Q&A about the upcoming co-op feature. Check it out to hear some of our plans for co-op, coming to LOTR: LCG by full release! Twitch.tv/ffigames

After you’ve watched the stream, join the discussion on the forums. 

[b]New Valor Cards and the First Encounter[/b]
13 all-new Valor Cards are coming next month! You’ll be able to add these cards to your collection using your Valor points. New cards on the horizon means that spoiler season is starting soon, so keep a lookout for previews of the incoming cards. 

Additionally, the first Encounter is coming in November, too. Titled The King of Carrion, this Encounter is a new stand-alone Quest available free for all players. We’ll preview The King of Carrion on stream before its release, so stay tuned.

[h1]Known bugs and Upcoming Fixes[/h1]

[b]Challenges Not Tracking[/b]
 Users were reporting that certain daily challenges were failing to track. We have a fix ready to deploy that will go live on Monday.  

[b]Sting in the Valor Vault [/b]
Some users had noticed that Sting was appearing in the Valor Vault, but couldn’t be unlocked. This is because Sting is intended as the first new card reward. The first time a player completes a Campaign or Encounter, they’ll be rewarded with a new card added to their collection. Sting is intended as the retroactive reward for Campaign 1, The Shadow’s Reach. 

Due to an unforeseen bug, Sting showed up in the Valor Vault, but users cannot unlock it. We’re working to get this fixed as a two-step process—first, Sting will be removed from the Vault, and second, Sting will be awarded to players who have completed the campaign. 

[b]Multiple Starter Decks [/b]
Some users have reported that they have multiple starter decks in their collection. If this happens to you, let us know on Helpshift and we’ll get it sorted right away. 

Phew! That’s a lot, but never fear; we didn’t forget your weekly decklist! 

User Ear-a-corn put together this humans-only deck as a self-imposed challenge and was surprised to find it was rather competitive, scoring a perfect 275 on four Quests. Give it a shot! 

[h1]Deck: Oh, the Humanity! [/h1]
Heroes
Aragorn 
Éowyn 
Faramir 
Ally (14)
2x Erkenbrand
2x Escort from Edoras
2x Guard of the Citadel
2x Ithilien Lookout
2x Rhovanion Outrider
2x Rohirrim Lancer
2x Warden of Annúminas
Attachment (8)
2x Gondorian Shield
2x Ranger's Blade
2x Self-Preservation
2x Unexpected Courage
Event (8)
2x A Watchful Peace
2x Beorn's Hospitality
2x Gaining Strength
2x Lembas


Thanks everyone! It’s been a busy week and eventful two months. We’re grateful for everyone who has joined us on this ride, and we can’t wait to show you what we have in store for the rest of Early Access and beyond. 

Have a great weekend,
FFI

notes.title: Economy Update, Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/202599b28beca4180055ad25530c8573a4d1a130.png[/img]

Hi Everyone, 

Last week, we made an announcement about the incoming change to the economy in The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game. Today, we have some news to share about how those changes will impact the existing Founder’s Packs.

[b]Tonight’s Updates[/b]
During the next scheduled downtime at 6 AM UTC, we’ll be gifting everyone the existing Hero Packs. If you’ve unlocked the packs previously, you’ll get 4000 VP per pack unlocked. [b]You’ll also receive the Valor you spent on additional copies of cards from those Hero Packs.[/b] This includes Hero Pack cards unlocked with Valor AND Hero Pack cards earned from the Palantìr If you run into any trouble during this update, let us know on Helpshift. Just like with the Campaign compensation, this compensation may take some time as we check each user’s account. Thank you in advance for your patience. 

The downtime will be a bit longer than usual, we expect. It’ll go closer to a full hour. 

[b]The Palantìr will also be removed at this time, so as we mentioned this morning, don’t forget to spend your Palantìr Views![/b]

There will be some changes to the in-game menus after the changeover—for instance, the Palantìr menu will be removed, and the deckbuilder will receive some ongoing quality-of-life improvements. We’ll want your feedback on these updates, so let us know what you think! 

[b]Founder’s Pack Updates[/b]
These incoming economy changes call for us to rethink how the Founder’s Packs will work during Early Access. As we unlock the core content as a baseline for all users, we want to reward the players who have been with us since our Early Access launch. Since each Founder’s Pack features a different price level and amount of rewards, we’re using that as a guide to make sure everyone sees value in the new model.  Here’s what each level of Founder’s Pack will be getting under the new economy:

[b]The Shire Pack[/b]
[i]The new Core Set[/i]
The Core Set includes the four original Heroes, the 4 currently available Hero Packs, the Core set of 68 (34x2) cards, the first Campaign (The Shadow’s Reach), and the first wave of cosmetics. 

[i]Valor Point Gift of 8000 VP[/i]
We’re gifting Shire Pack owners with 8000 VP, which was the original amount of VP granted under this Founder’s Pack. This won’t affect Valor Point purchases already made by users. 

[i]Underhill Card Back[/i]
All Shire Pack owners will get a new exclusive card back.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/253a24672a8b0da1a7cfff4a4f3cfd9c144d067f.png[/img]

[b]Steward of Gondor Pack[/b]
[i]The Core Set[/i]
The Core Set includes the four original Heroes, the 4 currently available Hero Packs, the Core set of 68 (34x2) cards, the first Campaign (The Shadow’s Reach), and the first wave of cosmetics. 

[i]Valor Point Gift of 16,000 VP[/i]
Steward Pack owners are getting 16000 Valor Points, which was the original amount of VP granted under this Founder’s Pack. This won’t affect Valor Point purchases already made by users. 

[i]Flame of the West Card Back[/i]
An exclusive Steward of Gondor card back.

[i]Alt art Tom Took[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Wrap-Up: October 18, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/960c8c1bb2cc8e54573e7feff9f0de1efbc95fa4.png[/img]

Happy Friday! 

On Tuesday, we made some big announcements. Most of the incoming changes won’t matter until Full Release, but a couple will take effect next Tuesday. As a result, we have a few important things to go over in this week’s Wrap-Up! Let’s jump right in. 

[b]The Palantìr is Going Away[/b]
 You can read our reasoning behind this change in our full announcement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/3644993759261680448]here[/url], but basically, the Palantìr wasn’t working the way we had hoped. As a result, we’re scrapping the feature. This means that we advise you to spend your Palantìr Views by next Tuesday, October 23, as the feature will be removed from the game after that. Gaze into the Palantìr while you can! 

[b]Hero Pack Unlock[/b]
Everyone is getting all four available Hero Packs for free, with two copies of the player cards they include. They’ll be unlocked in everyone’s collection on Tuesday, October 23. As a result, everyone who previously unlocked said Hero Packs will be awarded 4000 VP for each pack they unlocked. The process will be similar to the previous Campaign unlock, so if there are any hiccups in the process, let us know by filing a [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/asmodee-net/]HelpShift request.[/url]

[b]Economy Change for Full Release[/b]
The changes above are happening in anticipation of a bigger changeover at Full Release. We’ll be pivoting from a free-to-play model to a more traditional release at full release, based on expansions and a “Core Set,” something closer to the tabletop LCG model. You can read more about the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509580/announcements/detail/3644993759261680448]here.[/url] 

[b]Gameplay Hitches[/b]
A small number of users have reported that some cards are “hanging” after they’re played, stopping or slowing progress in the game. We’re investigating this issue to find a fix. 

[b]Incomplete Challenges[/b]
Some players have reported that some challenges are failing to complete even after they meet their conditions. We’re tracking this bug closely. If it happens to you, please let us know which specific challenges are failing to complete—it’ll help us track down and squash this bug. 

[b]Hero Threat Changes[/b]

notes.title: An Update on The Economy of The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31419660/202599b28beca4180055ad25530c8573a4d1a130.png[/img]

We have always seen Early Access as an ongoing conversation with you, the players.  Since August, we’ve carried on that conversation in a variety of ways—here on Steam, on Twitch, at shows and conventions—about card balance, visual presentation, user interface, and more, and we’ve taken your responses to heart.

One topic has come up again and again since launch. It’s something we’ve spent a great deal of time discussing internally: Economy. 

We’ve been carefully considering the feedback from users regarding how the game is sold and purchased.  After discussing various possibilities, today we’re ready to announce a few major changes in direction.

First off: [b]The Palantír is going away.[/b] The Palantír was intended as a reward system—sort of a grab-bag for high level players who earned an extra reward for playing and engaging with the game. 

In practice, however, the Palantír felt out of place and confusing. Put simply, it came across too much like a lootbox. We looked at ways to mitigate that, but we’re still not satisfied with the way it’s been implemented, and so, in one week, we’ll be removing it from the game.  

As a result: [b]We advise you to spend your remaining Palantír Views as soon as possible.[/b] You’ll retain all the Valor, cosmetics, and cards you already have or will get from the Palantír, but after October 23, the Palantír feature will be removed from the game.

That’s a big change, but not the only one we have in mind.  We have something else in the works.  

We want to bring the game’s economy more in-line with the tabletop LCG model.  As a result, we will be changing how the game is sold when we come out of Full Release. We’re taking steps now to prepare for that changeover.

When The Lord of the Rings: Living Card Game enters Full Release, we plan to change the game from a Free-To-Play title to a more conventional game release.  The content currently available during Early Access will become the basis for the “Core Set.” Following that, future Expansion Packs will give players new Hero Packs and quests as part of a single bundled expansion. We will detail the specifics of the new Core Set and Expansion Packs in a future news update. 

From a practical standpoint, this changeover won’t mean much for Early Access users. During Early Access, new users will still be able to unlock access to the game through the Founder’s Packs, which will remain largely the same.  

However, there is a practical change that we want to alert you to now. At the same time we remove the Palantír, [b]we will be giving everyone all of the currently available Hero Packs, with two copies of each player card included in those packs.[/b] We’re unlocking them for everyone who has purchased any level of Founder’s Pack either previously, or new players leading up to Full Release. That means that if you have access to the game, you’re getting every Hero Pack next Tuesday, October 23.

[b]If you’ve already purchased or unlocked any of the Hero Packs, we’ll be gifting you 4000 Valor Points for each pack you’ve unlocked.[/b] This process will be similar to the Quest Unlock from back in early September—we’ll simply add the Valor to players’ accounts.

So, what can you spend that Valor on? Valor cards will still be unlockable through Valor Points. We want Valor Points to serve more like Experience Points in an RPG.  Instead of using those points to level up, however, you’ll use them to unlock new Valor Cards.

 As part of our ongoing expansion plan, we will have new Valor Card releases coming several times a year.  In fact, [b]we’re happy to announce that an all-new set of Valor Cards will be coming next month. [/b]

That’s not all: [b]The first of our new free Encounters, a brand new, ultra-hard stand-alone Quest, will be released for all users for free next month as well. [/b]We’ve previewed some of the things to come in this first Encounter, titled The King of Carrion, on stream at twitch.tv/ffigames. Head there for a first look. 

That’s a fair bit of news, so let’s recap: 

-The Palantír is going away on Tuesday, October 23. Use your Palantír Views now!  
-All Hero Packs will be unlocked for everyone in Early Access on Tuesday, October 23. Players who already unlocked or purchased those Hero Packs will receive 4000 Valor for each pack they unlocked. 
-The next round of all-new Valor Cards are arriving in November.  
-The first Encounter, The King of Carrion, is arriving in November, free for all players. 

Thank you to everyone who has joined us on this ongoing journey to full release. 

The FFI Team

[b]Connection Issues[/b]
